Name: Dark Justicar
Description: Seal of Vengeance now stacks up to 10.  Your Judgements and Scourge Strike can consume 10 stacks of its damage over time effect to deal 17 additional Holy damage.

Name: Dark Surgeon
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Rogue finishing moves apply Surgical Treatment per combo point spent.    Premeditation now grants 1 additional combo point and can be used out of stealth.    Surgical Treatment Heals each second for 33. Lasts 6 sec.

Name: Dark Tonic
Description: Teaches you: Dark Tonic    Dark Tonic 3 min cooldown 50 Rage This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Drink a dark tonic, healing you for 124, scaling with your Stamina, and increasing your maximum health by 15% for 15 sec.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Dark Winter
Description: Dealing damage with Frost spells now applies Dark Winter.    Dark Winter Increases your periodic shadow damage dealt to the target by 2%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Darkwing Volley
Description: Dealing damage with Black Arrow reduces the remaining cooldown of Summon Gargoyle by 3 sec.

Name: Dawning Light
Description: Your Holy Shock healing is now increased by 50% on allies below 50% health.

Name: Deadly Aim
Description: Your ranged auto shots now have a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Aimed Shot and increase its damage by 15% for 6 sec.

Name: Deadly Bite
Description: Dealing damage with Mongoose Bite, Counterattack or Savage Blade applies Deadly Bite for 12 sec, causing 40% of the triggering damage as Bleed damage over its duration.    Repeated applications accumulate into the existing bleed and refresh its duration.      Deadly Bite Bleeding for accumulated damage equal to 40% of the triggering Mongoose Bite, Counterattack or Savage Blade damage over 12 sec. Reapplying Deadly Bite adds the new damage to the remaining bleed and refreshes the duration.

Name: Deadly Combo
Description: Requires  Sudden Death (Rank 3)  Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Sudden Death.      Sudden Death You may use Execute regardless of target's health.

Name: Deadly Instinct
Description: Dealing damage with Savage Blade now grants you Deadly Instinct.     Deadly Instinct Increases the damage of your Counterattack and Mongoose Bite by 50% against monsters.  This has 5 charges and lasts 15 sec.    Counterattack and Mongoose Bite deal 35% increased damage against players.

Name: Deadly Leap
Description: Heroic Leap now deals 25% increased damage. If Heroic Leap kills an enemy the cooldown is reset.

Name: Death or Glory
Description: Last Stand now dispels all harmful magic effects on you and boosts your melee attack power, speed, and movement by 10% for 10 seconds.

Name: Death's Due
Description: Teaches you: Death's Due    Death's Due 30 yd range 1.5 min cooldown 30 Rage 1 sec cast This spell belongs to Necromancer    Force a target to accept the reality of death, removing any invulnerability or immunity effects from them and cursing them for 5 sec.    If the target's health is below 20% at the end of the duration, they take 802 Shadowfrost damage.

Name: Deathball
Description: Teaches you: Deathball    Deathball 2 min cooldown 16 Mana This spell belongs to Tinker    Launch 3 Deathballs in a line, increasing in speed the further they travel.    They explode when they come into contact with an enemy, dealing 487 Fire damage to nearby enemies, increased based on distance traveled.

Name: Debilitating Roar
Description: The cooldown of your Challenging Roar and Challenging Shout is reduced by 12 sec and their duration is increased by 1 sec.    Your Challenging Roar and Challenging Shout also reduce affected enemies' damage done by 15%.

Name: Decimation by Pyro
Description: Your Decimation also increases the damage of your Pyroblast and Meteor by 25%.

Name: Defense of Thundarian
Description: Dealing damage with Windfury now grants you Cloaked in Wind.    Cloaked in Wind Reduces your magic damage taken by 2% and increases your armor by 3%. Lasts 6 sec. Stacks up to 2 times.

Name: Defiance
Description: Teaches you: Defiance    Defiance 3 min cooldown This spell belongs to Barbarian    Attempt to defy death, reducing all damage taken by 10% to 40% based on your current missing health for 10 sec.

Name: Defias Gunslinger
Description: Requires  Duelist's Glove  A Duelist's Glove is an off-hand item that enables Swashbuckling. It is granted whenever you learn a talent or ability that requires it.    Sinister Strike now grants you Gunslinger's Strike.    Gunslinger's Strike Increases the damage of your next Raptor Strike by 50%. Lasts 12 sec.    Damage increased by 30% against players.

Name: Defias Tactics
Description: Using Sinister Strike and Multi-Shot now reduce the active cooldown of your Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite by 2 second.

Name: Demolisher
Description: Your Mortal Strike now applies Demolish.    Demolish Increases your physical damage dealt to the target by 2%. Your melee critical strikes add an additional stack. Upon reaching 6 stacks your next melee critical strike consumes them. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Demonic Influence
Description: While in Metamorphosis your Summoned Demon, Demon and Wild Imps gain Demonic Influence.      Demonic Influence Damage increased by 30% and regenerates 500 mana every 5 seconds. Benefits Wild Imps.

Name: Demonic Persistence
Description: Your Wild Imps from Hand of Gul'dan are now overcharged with Fel energy, causing them to deteriorate over time. This causes your Incinerate and Mind Blast to trigger Demonic Persistence.    Demonic Persistence Sacrifices the lowest-health Wild Imp, dealing 140 to 180 Fire damage to targets within 8 yards. Increases the damage of your active Demon by 20% and your Wild Imps by 20%, stacking up to 4 times. For each demon detonated, your Wild Imps last 1 additional second per stack of Demonic Persistence.  Requires a Demon

Name: Demonic Reoccurence
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Metamorphosis by 50%. Metamorphosis grants 90% less bonus armor and no longer reduces your chance to be critically hit or the duration of stuns and snares.  Reduces the bonus damage by 10% against players.

Name: Demonic Synergy
Description: Critically striking with a direct damage spell increases your Wild Imps and Summoned Demon's critical chance by 30%. This effect is consumed on your pet's next critical hit.

Name: Deranged Druid
Description: Your offensive Druid spell casts & Feral abilities have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Druid spell for free.

Name: Destabilize Time
Description: Teaches you: Destabilize Time    Destabilize Time 35 yd range 17 Mana This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Reduces enemy casting speed by 10% for 20 sec, increasing by 10% every time they cast.    Gaining stacks does not extend the duration of the spell.

Name: Deter and Punish
Description: Your Deterrence also reflects spells and retaliates against attacks.

Name: Devil's Claws
Description: You now gain 7 seconds of Devil's Claws when casting Searing Pain or Cat-a-clysm and 15 seconds when casting Berserk.    Devil's Claws Claw, Shred, Ravage and Mangle deal additional Fire damage, cost 15 less energy, and restore 7% of your mana.

Name: Devouring
Description: Applying Warlock and Death Knight damage over time effects refreshes your Devouring Plague's duration on the target.

Name: Direct Command
Description: Increases the damage of your Seal of Command by 20% but it now only hits 1 additional target.

Name: Disciple of the Tides
Description: Direct Nature critical heals now grant you Disciple of the Tides.    Disciple of the Tides Increases the damage or healing of your next Penance by 15%.     Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 20 sec.

Name: Divine Charge
Description: Teaches you: Divine Charge    Divine Charge 3 min cooldown This spell belongs to Templar    You and your party members leap upon a divine steed, increasing their movement speed by 100% and causing them to trample nearby enemies for 66 Holy damage every 0.50 sec for 6 sec.    While active, casting does not dismount you or your allies. Can only be used outdoors.

Name: Divine Circle
Description: Your Flash Heal and Greater Heal now grant you Empowered Circle of Healing    Empowered Circle of Healing Increases the effect of your next Circle of Healing by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Divine Concord
Description: The Art of War now makes Arcane Blast instant.    When Arcane Blast consumes The Art of War, it grants one additional Arcane Blast stack. While Harnessed Energy is active, it grants one additional Harnessed Energy charge instead.

Name: Divine Ferocity
Description: Mongoose Bite and Counterattack increase the damage of your next Divine Storm by 50%. Stacks up to 5 times.

Name: Divine Guidance
Description: Dealing damage with Penance now grants you Divine Guidance.    Divine Guidance Your next healing Penance deals 25% increased healing and causes each bolt to radiate outward, healing 5 nearby allies for 5 and reducing the cooldown of Penance by 1 second.

Name: Divine Judgement
Description: Healing with Penance now grants you Divine Judgement.    Divine Judgement Your next damaging Penance deals 75% increased damage and causes each bolt to explode, dealing 9 additional Holy damage to 5 nearby enemies and reducing the cooldown of Penance by 1 second.    Penance deals 35% increased damage against players.

Name: Divine Prophet
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Blast, Arcane Missiles and Arcane Barrage now grant you Divine Wrath.    Divine Wrath Increases the damage of your next Smite or Holy Fire by 25%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Divine Reset
Description: Direct damaging Holy spells and abilities have a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Divine Storm.

Name: Dominant Word: Shield
Description: Your Power Word: Shield now absorbs for an additional 50% when cast on allies below 75% health.    Damaging casts of Smite, Holy Fire, and Penance now grant a stack of Dominant Shield.    Dominant Shield stacks can only be obtained from Penance every 2 seconds.    Dominant Shield Increases the amount absorbed by your next Power Word: Shield by 15%, but reduces its duration by 1 sec. Stacks up to 10 times. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Doomhammer's Fury
Description: Casting Lava Lash now grants you Doomhammer's Fury.    Doomhammer's Fury Your Pyroblast and Lava Burst now restore mana, generate a stack of Maelstrom Weapon, and deal 13% increased direct damage. Lasts for 8 sec.

Name: Double Down
Description: Your Sinister Strike and its Classless transforms, including Eclipse Strike, also strike with your off-hand weapon, but no longer generate combo points.

Name: Double Team
Description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Double Team.      Double Team Increases your Tamed Beast's special attack damage by 80% against monsters or 40 to 39% against players. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Down For The Count
Description: Your Killing Spree hits cause an additional strike for 15% of the damage dealt when attacking a bleeding or poisoned enemy.

Name: Draconic Aspect
Description: Teaches you: Draconic Aspect    Draconic Aspect 3 min cooldown 3 sec cast This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Assume a draconic aspect for 30 sec, changing your appearance and increasing spell power by 30% of your Intellect.

Name: Draconic Might
Description: Casting Charge, Intercept, Feral Charge, and Dragon Roar now grants you Draconic Might.    Draconic Might Increases melee and ranged critical strike chance and haste by 5%. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Draconic Slam
Description: Dealing damage with Bloodthirst and Execute grants you Draconic Slam.    Draconic Slam Your next Slam is instant and deals 50% increased damage. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Dragon Warrior
Description: Casting Slam now grants you Dragon Fury.     Dragon Fury Reduces the cooldown of your next Dragon Roar by 5 seconds and increases its damage done by 20%. Stacks up to 3 times.    At max stacks, Dragon Roar stuns enemies for 2 seconds.

Name: Dreadnaught
Description: Dealing damage with Overpower, Slam and Rune Strike now unleashes a wave of force in front of you dealing 9 Physical damage to 6 targets in front of you.    This effect can only occur once every 4 sec.

Name: Druidic Storm
Description: While Nature's Grace is active, the damage of Chain Lightning, Lightning Bolt and Earth Shock is increased by 35%. Nature's Grace lasts 2 seconds longer.

Name: Dusk Till Dawn
Description: Damaging spells with a cast time grant you Dusk Till Dawn.    Dusk Till Dawn Increases the damage of your next Shadowburn by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.    When used at 5 stacks, Shadowburn will hit 5 additional targets.

Name: Earth's Blessing
Description: Direct healing an ally affected by your Earth Shield restores two Earth Shield charges and grants them Earth's Blessing.    Earth's Blessing Increases your chance to critically heal the target by 3%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Earth's Embrace
Description: Teaches you: Earth's Embrace    Earth's Embrace 5 min cooldown 26 Mana This spell belongs to Primalist    Encapsulate your body in amber, becoming immune to all Physical attacks and spells for 8 sec, and healing you for 300 every 2 sec, but making you unable to move or act.  Usable while stunned, feared, or polymorphed.

Name: Eccentric Elementalist
Description: Your offensive Shaman spell casts have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Shaman spell for free.

Name: Eclipse Bomber
Description: When you gain Eclipse (Solar) you also gain Solar Bomber, causing your Fireball and Pyroblast to grant you Lunar Flames.    When you gain Eclipse (Lunar) you also gain Lunar Bomber, causing your Starfire and Starsurge to grant you Solar Flames.      Lunar Flames Increases the damage of your Starfire and Starsurge by 12%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 18 sec or until you gain Eclipse (Solar).    Solar Flames Increases the damage of Fireball and Pyroblast by 18%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 18 sec or until you gain Eclipse (Lunar).

Name: Electrical Discharge
Description: Dealing damage with Mangle (Bear) has a 15% chance to deal 60% of its damage as Nature damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Elemental Anomaly
Description: While Hot Streak and Fingers of Frost are both active, your next Pyroblast unleashes an Elemental Anomaly dealing 264 Frostfire damage.

Name: Elemental Assassin
Description: Dealing damage with Ambush and Backstab now grant you Elemental Assassin.    Elemental Assassin Increases the direct damage of your next Shaman Shock by 100%. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 8 sec.    Increases the damage of your next Shaman Shock by 80% versus players.

Name: Elemental Burst
Description: Dealing damage with Elemental Blast now reduces the time between Searing Totem attacks by 50%. Lasts 5 seconds.

Name: Elemental Conviction
Description: While Improved Judgements Capstone is active, your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Burst, and Elemental Blast can trigger your active Seal of Righteousness or Vengeance.

Name: Elemental Daggers
Description: Using Earth Shock, Flame Shock or Frost Shock grants the matching Elemental Dagger.    Each active Elemental Dagger increases your Backstab and Ambush damage by 40% against monsters.    Damage is increased damage by 30% against players.    While all three Elemental Daggers are active, your next Backstab or Ambush deals additional Elemental damage.

Name: Elemental Destruction
Description: Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning grants Elemental Destruction.      Elemental Destruction Increases the damage of your active Immolate by 40%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 10 sec or until you cast Immolate or Conflagrate.

Name: Elemental Domination
Description: Elemental Blast has no cooldown and its cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec, but it no longer grants its buffs.

Name: Elemental Equilibrium
Description: Dealing direct damage with a Fire, Frost, and Nature spell within 10 seconds now grants you Elemental Equilibrium.    Multi-school spells may trigger all elements but only once per cast.    Elemental Equilibrium Increases your Fire, Frost and Nature damage by 10%. Lasts for 14 sec.

Name: Elemental Fusion
Description: Casting Shaman Shocks increases the damage of your Stormstrike and Lava Lash by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.    Frost Shock, Earth Shock and Flame Shock can each trigger this effect once every 10 sec.

Name: Elemental Lord
Description: Your Elemental Blast and Lava Burst empower you at random with Elemental Earth, Elemental Frost or Elemental Fire.  The selected shock spell deals 100% increased direct damage.    Elemental Earth Earth Shock triggers aftershocks, dealing additional damage to 3 nearby targets over 3 seconds.   Elemental Frost Frost Shock causes your next Lava Burst to solidify, dealing 55% more damage.   Elemental Fire Empowers your next Flame Shock direct damage to have a 100% chance and its periodic damage to have a 20% chance to reset the cooldown of Lava Burst.

Name: Elemental Reload
Description: Dealing damage with Elemental Blast resets the cooldown of Chimera Shot.

Name: Elemental Surge of Light
Description: When you use a non-Holy spell to trigger Surge of Light, your next Smite or Flash Heal can now critically hit.

Name: Elune's Fury
Description: Periodic damage from your Moonfire and Insect Swarm can now critically hit.

Name: Elune's Presence
Description: Teaches you: Elune's Presence    Elune's Presence 3 min cooldown 18 Mana This spell belongs to Starcaller    Gain the blessing of a goddess, granting all party or raid members within 40 yds 20% temporary maximum health for 10 sec.

Name: Ember Touch
Description: Teaches you: Ember Touch    Ember Touch 15 sec cooldown 16 Mana This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Warm an ally with everliving flames, healing them for 95, increased by scales with Spirit.

Name: Embracing Shadows
Description: While Shadow Dance is active, taking spell damage heals you and extends Shadow Dance by 0.3 seconds.

Name: Empowered Light
Description: Crusader Strike, Divine Storm, Hammer of Wrath, Judgements, Aimed Shot, Kill Shot and Chimera Shot now grant you Empowered Light.    Empowered Light Reduces the cast time of next Holy Fire by 33%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: En Garde!
Description: Requires  Duelist's Glove  A Duelist's Glove is an off-hand item that enables Swashbuckling. It is granted whenever you learn a talent or ability that requires it. Requires a one-handed weapon and does not work while shapeshifted.    Requires  Defensive Stance  While Swashbuckling, converts 15% of your Agility into Parry Rating.    Your finishing moves reduce the duration of your active Stagger effect by 0.6 sec per combo point.

Name: Encroaching Storm
Description: Consuming a fully stacked Maelstrom Weapon reduces the cooldown of Shamanistic Rage and Elemental Mastery by 6 seconds, and the cooldown of Air Ascendance by 3 seconds.

Name: Endbringer
Description: Teaches you: Endbringer    Endbringer 3 min cooldown This spell belongs to Reaper    For 15 sec, increase all damage you deal against targets bellow 35% health by 30%.

Name: Endless Agonizer
Description: Dealing damage with Mind Blast or Shadow Word: Death grants you Endless Agonizer.    Endless Agonizer Casting Shadow spells and dealing damage with Mind Flay increases the duration of your Curse of Agony on the target by 1 second.  The duration can be extended by up to 12 seconds. Recasting Curse of Agony resets the counter.  Lasts for 12 sec.

Name: Endless Agony
Description: Your Curse of Agony damage build up is now 25% stronger, and benefits from spell haste.    Dealing direct spell damage now applies Endless Agony.    Endless Agony Increases your damage dealt to the target with Curse of Agony and Curse of Doom by 10%. Stacks up to 25 times and lasts 6 sec.

Name: Endless Flames
Description: Increases the duration of Shadowflame and Pyroclasm by 9 seconds.

Name: Endless Flurry
Description: Your auto attacks now reduce the active cooldown of Blade Flurry by 2 seconds.

Name: Engaging Shots
Description: Your Hunter Shots reduce the cooldown of Disengage by 1 seconds.    This effect can only occur once every 1 sec. Reduces the cooldown by 0.5 seconds when used against players.

Name: Enhanced Marksmanship
Description: Requires  Maelstrom Weapon (Rank 3)  Your ranged attacks have a 20% chance grant Maelstrom Weapon.

Name: Enraging Finale
Description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Bloodrage if known.    This effect can only occur once every 20 sec and cannot occur if Bloodrage is active.

Name: Entropic Singularity
Description: Teaches you: Entropic Singularity    Entropic Singularity 30 yd range 1 min cooldown 9 Mana This spell belongs to Cultist    Create a void zone for 5 sec at target location that slows enemies' movement speed while inside.    The slow increases in intensity based on how close to the middle of the zone the enemy is.

Name: Envenomed Weapons
Description: Teaches you: Envenomed Weapons    Envenomed Weapons 2 min cooldown 12 Mana This spell belongs to Venomancer    Envenoms the weapons of all nearby allies for 30 sec, giving them a 5% chance to launch a jet of poison at their target whenever they deal damage, dealing 4 Nature damage.

Name: Eruption
Description: Dealing damage with Lava Lash grants Eruption.    Eruption Increases the critical strike chance of your next Pyroblast by 15%. Consuming this empowers your Flametongue Attacks to erupt onto nearby enemies. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Eternity
Description: When your Align, Synchronize or Time-Bind spells reduce you to 0 energy, you gain Eternity.    Eternity A wave of healing radiates from you, increasing your energy generation by 250% and cast speed by 20%. You restore 5% missing mana every 1.5 sec. Lasts for 2 sec.    Each stack of Temporal Distortion increases Eternity's healing by 13% and duration by 0.3 sec.

Name: Ethereal Echostrike
Description: Dealing damage with Unfair Advantage grants you Ethereal Echostrike and resets the cooldown of Riposte.    This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.    Ethereal Echostrike Your next Riposte deals 50% increased damage, generates additional threat, and strikes up to 6 nearby targets. Lasts for 8 sec.

Name: Ethereal Tricks
Description: Spellsteal and Thief of Fate now steals an extra magic effect.

Name: Evergreen
Description: Your Regrowth and Healing Touch now refresh the duration of your Lifebloom.

Name: Everlasting Fire
Description: Your Exorcism, Hammer of Wrath and Judgement abilities increase the duration of your Holy Fire by 3 seconds.

Name: Evoker
Description: Consuming Arcane Evoked or Fire Evoked from your Spellstorm grants you Frost Evoked.     Frost Evoked Frostbolt casts 3% quicker and grants you Evoker. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.    Evoker Increases your damage by 4% and critical strike chance by 2%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 8 sec.

Name: Exorcist's Bite
Description: Dealing damage with Exorcism increases the damage share inherited by Deadly Bite by 50% for 6 seconds.

Name: Exploding Storm
Description: Stormstrike and Lava Lash now grant you Exploding Storm.    Exploding Storm Increases the damage dealt with Immolation Trap by 35% and Explosive Trap by 25%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 20 sec.

Name: Exponential Spell Reflections
Description: Spell Reflection reflects 2 additional spells, but its cooldown is increased by 50%.

Name: Expunge
Description: Your Chimera Shot or Mongoose Bite now applies Cobra Venom.       Cobra Venom Deals Nature damage every 3 seconds for 15 sec. If this reaches 3 stacks or the target dies, Cobra Venom is Expunged, dealing 24 Nature damage to enemies within 10 yards.

Name: Exsanguinate
Description: Hunger for Blood now increases the damage of your Garrote, Rupture, and Crimson Tempest by 40%.

Name: Extraction
Description: Teaches you: Extraction    Extraction 5 min cooldown This spell belongs to Venomancer    Increase all stats by 15% for 15 sec.

Name: Faerie Swarm
Description: Your Faerie Fire (Feral) now applies Insect Swarm.

Name: Faith in the Elements
Description: Dealing damage with Smite extends your Flame Shock on the target by 2 sec and reduces the remaining cooldown of Lava Burst by 1 sec.

Name: Falcon's Call
Description: Teaches you: Falcon's Call    Falcon's Call 40 yd range 1.5 min cooldown 30 Mana 2 sec cast This spell belongs to Ranger    Call down war falcons upon a targeted area, slowing enemies within the area by 60% for 5 sec.    A Falcon is summoned for each enemy affected for 12 sec.

Name: Favour of the Spirit
Description: Effective direct Holy heals reduce the cooldown of Penance by 2 seconds.  This cannot trigger from channeled spells.

Name: Fel Core
Description: Using Bloodthirst increases the chance to trigger Molten Core by 2%. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 12 sec.    Your Molten Core also empowers Chaos Bolt, increasing its damage by 20% and critical strike chance by 15%.

Name: Feral Savagery
Description: Dealing direct ability damage while in cat form grants you Razor Claws.    Razor Claws Increases Physical damage done by 2% and increases the damage of Bloodthirst by 10%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Festering Wound
Description: Your Envenom attacks now apply Festering Wound.    Festering Wound Increases your Nature damage dealt to the target by 4%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Fetch Me Their Bones!
Description: Your damaging Hunter abilities reduce the cooldown of Kill Command by 2 seconds.    Using Kill Command makes your pet Charge to your current target if within 20 yards of it and deal 400% of its attack damage to it and its nearby enemies.

Name: Final Shield
Description: Casting Power Word: Shield on an ally below 20% health also removes any Crowd Control effects on them.    This effect can only occur once every 30 sec.

Name: Fingers of Death
Description: When you gain Fingers of Frost, you also gain Fingers of Death.   Fingers of Death Casting Ice Lance also launches a Shadow Lance dealing 177 Shadow damage. Casting Ice Lance while Fingers of Death is active grants you Touch of Death.   Touch of Death Increases the damage of your next Vampiric Touch by 60%. Lasts for 15 sec and can hold up to 2 charges.

Name: Fingers of Light
Description: Your direct Holy heals now grant you Fingers of Light.    Fingers of Light Increases your chance to proc Fingers of Frost by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 1 min or until it triggers.

Name: Fire Arsenal
Description: Casting Blast Wave, Dragon's Breath, Flamestrike, Hellfire, Rain of Fire or Shadowflame grants a powerful empowerment to one of these spells at random.

Name: Fire Fire Fireball
Description: After casting Fireball twice in combat, your third Fireball has its cast time increased by 0.4 sec and fires an additional wave of Fireballs toward your target.    Must be in combat for Cauterizing Fire healing to trigger this effect.

Name: Fire Walk With Me
Description: Your Flamestrike now increases the movement speed of allies who walk through it by 50%.

Name: Fire Watch
Description: Dealing damage with Immolation Trap and Explosive Trap now grants you Fire Watch.    Fire Watch Your next Mongoose Bite, Raptor Strike, or Counterattack deals an additional 5 Fire damage. Can store up to 5 charges and lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Firestorm
Description: Teaches you: Firestorm    Firestorm 30 yd range 1 min cooldown 20 Mana 1.5 sec cast This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Create a fiery tornado at a location for 10 sec.    Enemies who enter its radius suffer 70 Fire damage and are knocked back slightly.

Name: First to the Fight
Description: Your Shield Slam now lowers the cooldown of Shield Block by 2 seconds and grants a stack of Vanguard.      Vanguard Increases your Block Value by 2% and the armor gained from your shield by 10%. Stacks 5 times. Lasts 12 sec.

Name: Flame Born
Description: Critical strikes from Corruption and Unstable Affliction now grant you Flame Born.     Flame Born Increases the critical strike chance of your next Conflagrate by 25% and the periodic damage of your Shadowflame by 50%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Flame On!
Description: Your damaging Fireball, Scorch, Flamestrike and Pyroblast casts grant you Flame On!    Flame On! Increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast or Meteor by 33%.  Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 8 sec.

Name: Flash of Adrenaline
Description: The cooldown of Sprint is refreshed when your Adrenaline Rush expires.

Name: Flourishing Tranquility
Description: Casting Tranquility now extends the duration of your Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Wild Growth, Lifebloom, Riptide, Earthliving on all friendly targets within 40 yards by 6 sec.

Name: Flow of Life
Description: Your Tranquility now applies Flow of Life to healed allies and has a 20% reduced cooldown.    Flow of Life Increases your periodic healing on the target by 40% for 8 sec. Does not increase the healing of Tranquility.

Name: Flowing
Description: Casting Healing Touch now grants you Flowing. Reaching 3 stacks grants you Overflowing.    Overflowing Increases the healing of your next Chain Heal by 50% and healing is not diminished with each jump. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Focused Hunt
Description: Dealing damage with combo point generating abilities grants your Tamed Beast Focused Hunt.    Focused Hunt Your pet's special attacks grant you 7 energy. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Forbidden Dance
Description: Casting Forbidden Technique now grants you Forbidden Dance.    Forbidden Dance Your Ambush can be used from any position. Ambush costs 25 less energy and causes your Shadow to throw a Shadow Dagger at your target. Lasts 8 sec.    Ambush still requires you to be behind your target versus players.

Name: Forbidden Powers
Description: When Forbidden Technique ends, you absorb your shadow and gain Shadow Power.    Shadow Powers Your ranged abilities now launch a Shadow Dagger that deals 36% weapon damage as Shadow and reduces the cooldown of your Forbidden Technique by 3 seconds. Lasts 20 sec.    Forbidden Technique's cooldown is reduced by 1 second against players.

Name: Forbidden Ritual
Description: Teaches you: Forbidden Ritual    Forbidden Ritual 1 min cooldown 24 Mana 3 sec cast Requires  Path of Healing  This spell belongs to Cultist    Chant a forbidden ritual that places a shield on all nearby allies that absorbs 74 damage for 10 sec.

Name: Forked Lightning
Description: Chain Lightning generates extra lightning forks from every target hit.

Name: Foul Invocation
Description: Teaches you: Foul Invocation    Foul Invocation 2 min cooldown 20 Mana This spell belongs to Necromancer    Transform into an undead monstrosity for 20 sec, increasing your maximum health by 30%.    While transformed you are immune to Fear, Sleep, Charm, and Disease effects.

Name: Fracture
Description: Teaches you: Fracture    Fracture 6 sec cooldown 24 Mana This spell belongs to Runemaster    Strike an enemy with frozen fury, dealing 186 Frost damage.    Damage dealt is guaranteed to critically strike against frozen targets.

Name: Freezing Blood
Description: When Cold Blood is consumed, you gain Freezing Blood.   Freezing Blood Your Rogue abilities now deal an additional 10% Frost damage. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Freezing Strike
Description: Requires  Fingers of Frost (Rank 2)  Stormstrike and Frost Strike have a 15% chance to trigger Fingers of Frost.      Fingers of Frost Your spells and abilities treat the target as if it were Frozen. Holds 2 charges. Lasts for 15 seconds.

Name: Frenzied Growth
Description: Wild Growth now lasts 4 sec and does 100% increased healing, but heals 30% fewer targets.

Name: Frost Lich
Description: Dealing direct damage has a chance to chill your target, dealing Frost damage and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.    This effect can only occur once every 9 sec.

Name: Frost Pulse
Description: Dealing Frost damage against your Frost Bomb target releases a wave of freezing ice, dealing 19 Frost damage to nearby enemies and slowing their movement speed by 30% for 2 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 2 sec.

Name: Frost Reserve
Description: Water Shield increases your direct Frost damage by 3% per stack. Direct Frost spell damage consumes a Water Shield stack.    Summon Water Elemental grants you Water Shield if known, and its Water Bolt restores 2 charges of Water Shield.

Name: Frost Wyrm
Description: Teaches you: Frost Wyrm    Frost Wyrm 30 yd range 2 min cooldown 25 Mana This spell belongs to Necromancer    Summon a Frost Wyrm that flies behind you and blasts nearby enemies every 2 sec for 30 sec, dealing Frost damage.

Name: Frostflame Shock!
Description: Brain Freeze now affects Frostflame Shock.    Frostflame Shock! Your next Frostflame Shock is instant, costs no mana and increases the damage the target takes from your Icicles by 30%. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Frosty Frost Frostbolt
Description: Every third Frostbolt hits up to 5 additional enemies near your target, but has its cast time increased by 0.3 sec.

Name: Frozen Blade
Description: Requires  Fingers of Frost (Rank 1)  Your Eviscerate and Rupture now have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Fingers of Frost.    Fingers of Frost Your spells and abilities treat the target as if it were Frozen. Holds 2 charges. Lasts for 15 seconds.

Name: Frozen Chaos
Description: Your Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt, Ice Lance, Cone of Cold critical strikes now grant you Frozen Chaos and reset the cooldown of Chaos Bolt.    Frozen Chaos Next Chaos Bolt triggers no cooldown and has 15% increased damage.  Stores up to 4 charges and lasts for 45 sec.

Name: Frozen Flesh
Description: Your Deep Freeze and Howling Blast apply Frozen Flesh to your target.    Frozen Flesh Your next 3 Fire spells shatter the target's flesh, dealing 452 Frostfire damage and grant you Fire and Ice. Lasts for 10 sec.    Fire and Ice Increases the damage you deal by 4%. Stacks up to 3. Lasts for 8 sec.

Name: Frozen Reflexes
Description: Consuming Fingers of Frost with Mongoose Bite resets Mongoose Bite's cooldown.

Name: Frugal Disposition
Description: When you overheal with Lesser Healing Wave, your target receives half the overhealing periodically over 6 sec.  When your Lesser Healing Wave does not bring your ally to full health, your next Lesser Healing Wave is guaranteed to critically heal.

Name: Furnace Rhythm
Description: Dealing direct damage with Pyroblast grants Furnace Rhythm for 8 sec. Your next Bloodthirst has 30% increased critical strike chance. Consuming Furnace Rhythm grants 15% haste for 10 sec.

Name: Fury of the Light
Description: While Divine Illumination is active, your Holy critical damage bonus is increased by 30%.

Name: Garden of Growth
Description: Your Healing Touch and Nourish criticals now grant Garden of Growth to allies.    Garden of Growth Upon reaching 2 stacks, plants a Living Seed on your ally and blooms all Living Seeds within 30 yards without consuming them. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 30 sec.

Name: Gathering Dread
Description: Whenever you take damage, you have a 10% chance to accumulate Dread, increasing the damage of your next Reign of Dread by 5% per stack. At 15 stacks, Reign of Dread lasts an additional 2.5 sec.      Dread Increases the damage of your next Reign of Dread by 5% per stack. Stacks up to 15 times.    At 15 stacks, Reign of Dread lasts an additional 2.5 sec. Dread is removed when Reign of Dread ends.

Name: Gavel of Wrath
Description: Teaches you: Gavel of Wrath    Gavel of Wrath 5 sec cooldown 8 Mana This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Smash an enemy for 80% Weapon Damage plus 45 and dispel 1 beneficial magic effect from them.    Shares a cooldown with other Gavels.

Name: Gaze of C'Thun
Description: Teaches you: Gaze of C'Thun    Gaze of C'Thun 30 yd range 10 sec cooldown 12 Mana This spell belongs to Cultist    Set C'Thun's Gaze upon an enemy or ally, jumping to 1 additional nearby target. Deals 23 Shadow damage to enemies or heals allies for 21.

Name: Gaze of Ysera
Description: Teaches you: Gaze of Ysera    Gaze of Ysera 1.5 min cooldown 12 Mana This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Set Ysera's gaze upon an enemy, putting them to sleep for 40 sec (8 sec vs players).    Direct damage dealt may interrupt this effect.

Name: Glacial Companion
Description: Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks now deal Frost damage.    Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks can only be transformed to one damage type at once.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Glacial Pact
Description: Casting Ice Barrier or Summon Water Elemental grants your Water Elemental Frozen Waters.    Frozen Waters Summoned Water Elemental gains 150% increased damage against monsters. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Glacial Rune
Description: Teaches you: Glacial Rune    Glacial Rune 30 yd range 20 sec cooldown 7 Mana 1.25 sec cast This spell belongs to Runemaster    Place a rune at the target location that explodes after 1 sec with frigid magic, dealing 47 Frost damage to enemies inside and freezing them in place for 40 sec (8 sec vs players).    Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Glimmer of Light
Description: Flash of Light grants Glimmer of Light stacking up to 5 times. Lasts 20 sec.  Holy Shock consumes Glimmer of Light.   Glimmer of Light Increases the healing done by your Flash of Light by 40% and its mana cost by 100% per stack.  Increases the healing done by your next Holy Shock by 40% and causes it to heal an additional target per stack.

Name: Gloaming Embrace
Description: Casting Shadow Dance now applies 5 Shadow Marks on all enemies within 8 yards.    Using Ambush, Ravage or Deadly Throw on a Shadow Marked target grants you Gloaming Embrace.    Gloaming Embrace Increases all damage done by 4%, and Ambush and Hemorrhage by an additional 10% against monsters. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Golem Form
Description: Teaches you: Golem Form    Golem Form 3 min cooldown This spell belongs to Primalist    Transform into a golem for 30 sec, reducing Physical damage taken by 15%.

Name: Grace of Alexstrasza
Description: Teaches you: Grace of Alexstrasza    Grace of Alexstrasza 5 min cooldown 14 Mana This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Burn off all movement impairing effects from party and raid members within 20 yds and grant them stun, slow, and root immunity for 4 sec.

Name: Grasp of Zek'voz
Description: Teaches you: Grasp of Zek'voz    Grasp of Zek'voz 30 yd range 6 sec cooldown 8 Mana This spell belongs to Cultist    Hinder an enemies momentum with void chains, slowing their movement speed by 30% for 10 sec.

Name: Gravebound Champion
Description: Teaches you: Gravebound Champion    Gravebound Champion 5 min cooldown 12 Mana This spell belongs to Necromancer    Summon a Gravebound Champion that redirects 50% of all damage you take to itself for 20 sec.

Name: Green Salve
Description: Teaches you: Green Salve    Green Salve 40 yd range 10 sec cooldown 12 Mana This spell belongs to Venomancer    Rapidly heal an ally for 24 over 6 sec.    At the end of the duration, this will seek another nearby ally with the lowest health and heal them for 48.

Name: Grove Guardian
Description: Teaches you: Grove Guardian    Grove Guardian 3 min cooldown 16 Mana This spell belongs to Primalist    Mark a location as your Grove for 20 sec.   Allies within gain 30% movement speed and are healed for 205 every 5 sec, removing 1 poison and disease effect.   Enemies within are slowed by 30% and take 261 Nature damage every 5 sec and are rooted for 2 sec.

Name: Grove Ranger
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Using Hunter Shots now grants you Grove Ranger.   Stacks up to 2 times.    Grove Ranger Consumes up to 2 stacks to empower your next Wild Growth, Healing Touch or Regrowth. Consuming 2 stacks doubles the effect.    - Wild Growth: Heals 2 additional targets and its heal radius is increased by 5 yards.    - Healing Touch and Regrowth: Cast time reduced by 50% and mana cost reduced by 30%.    - Healing Touch: Heals an additional target and healing increased by 30%.

Name: Grove Ranger's Agility
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Increases your attack power by 120% of your Agility and your Healing Power by 20% of your Agility.

Name: Growing Corruption
Description: Targets afflicted by your Seed of Corruption increase your chance to critically strike them by 20%.    Seed of Corruption's explosion applies Corruption to targets it hits.

Name: Growing Earth
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Healing with Lifebloom and Rejuvenation now has a chance to grant you Growing Earth.    Growing Earth Reduces the cast time of your next Healing Wave or Healing Touch by 15%. Stacks up to 3 and lasts for 12 sec.  While at max stacks, Healing Wave and Healing Touch heal your ally for an additional 2 every 1 sec and increase their healing received from your Lifebloom and Rejuvenation by 25% for 5 sec.

Name: Growing Light
Description: Healing your Beacon of Light target with Holy heals causes it to radiate outward, healing 3 nearby allies within 8 yards for 20% of the healing done.

Name: Guerilla Tactics
Description: Dealing damage with Mongoose Bite, Counterattack, or Wing Clip now grants you Guerilla Tactics.    Guerilla Tactics Damage done by your Savage Blade, Chimera Shot, Aimed Shot and Explosive Shot is increased by 10%. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Guise
Description: Teaches you: Guise    Guise 2 min cooldown 25 Energy This spell belongs to Ranger    Generates 5 combo points over 10 sec and allows you to see nearby stealthed enemies.    Usable while stealthed.

Name: Gul'dan's Chosen
Description: Shadow Bolt, Soul Fire, Incinerate and Chaos Bolt have a 12% chance to grant Gul'dan's Chosen for 10 sec.    While active, Backdraft and Molten Core are not consumed.    This effect cannot trigger while Gul'dan's Chosen is active.

Name: Gurubashi Tactics
Description: Damaging abilities with a Rage cost other than Raging Blow grant a Raging Blow charge.  This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.

Name: Hallucination
Description: Teaches you: Hallucination    Hallucination 30 sec cooldown 12 Mana This spell belongs to Cultist    Create 3 copies of yourself that run in a random direction for 3 sec and may briefly trick enemies into ignoring you.     Significantly reduces your threat and removes all movement impairing effects from you.

Name: Hammer of Kings
Description: Teaches you: Hammer of Kings    Hammer of Kings 20 sec cooldown 12 Mana This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Become anointed by the light, summoning a blessed hammer that encircles you dealing 6 Holyfire Damage to nearby enemies every 3 sec for 12 sec.

Name: Hammer of Storms
Description: Dealing damage with Thunder Clap or Hammer of the Righteous grants you Hammer of Storms.    Hammer of Storms Your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Stormstrike damage is increased by 25%.

Name: Harbinger of Plague
Description: Casting Wrath now grants you Harbinger of Plague.    While affected by Harbinger of Plague, Haunt deals 30% of its damage to 10 nearby targets.      Harbinger of Plague Increases the damage of your diseases and Haunt by 15%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 8 sec.

Name: Harmonized Zeal
Description: Healing with Holy spells reduces the cooldown of Nature's Swiftness by 4 seconds

Name: Harnessed Energy
Description: Arcane Blast now grants Harnessed Energy instead of applying its normal stacking debuff.    Harnessed Energy Increases the damage of your next Arcane spell by 25% and increases the mana cost of Arcane Blast by 400%.    Stores up to 5 charges and lasts for 10 sec. Arcane Blast does not consume charges.

Name: Harvest Essence
Description: Shadow spells with a cast time grant Harvested Essence.    Harvested Essence Each stack causes your next Drain Life to channel 10% faster and reduces the time between its ticks by 10%.    Each stack reduces the time between ticks of your next Drain Soul by 15%.    Stacks up to 5. Lasts 10 sec.    Reduces the healing received from Drain Life by 80%.

Name: Harvesting Grounds
Description: Teaches you: Harvesting Grounds    Harvesting Grounds 30 yd range 2 min cooldown This spell belongs to Reaper    Create a harvesting ground at the target location for 10 sec. Enemies inside have their melee and ranged haste and movement speed reduced by 20%.    For the duration, enemies that try to exit the harvesting ground are pulled back to its center.

Name: Hastened Strikes
Description: Sweeping Strikes hits your primary target and increases your melee critical strike chance by 5%.  Successful melee attacks reduce the cooldown of Sweeping Strikes by 2 second.  This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

Name: Healing Garden
Description: Your direct Nature heals now extend the durations of Lifebloom, Rejuvenation, and Regrowth on your allies by 1.5 second.

Name: Heartchill
Description: Teaches you: Heartchill    Heartchill 30 sec cooldown 15 Mana This spell belongs to Necromancer    Chill an enemy's heart, interrupting their current spell cast.    Successfully interrupting a spell also reduces their movement speed and haste by 80% for 3 sec.

Name: Heating Up!
Description: Dealing direct damage with Conflagrate applies Heating Up!.    Heating Up! You deal 3% increased Fire damage to the target. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Heavyweight
Description: Using Overpower or Execute grants 2 stacks, and Slam grants 1 stack of Heavyweight stacking up to 6 times.    After reaching max stacks you gain Ready to Strike.    Ready to Strike Your next Mortal Strike deals 45% increased damage and has a 33% increased critical strike chance.     Your next Thunder Clap triggers a crushing blow, dealing 275% weapon damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Hellfire Form
Description: Teaches you: Hellfire Form    Hellfire Form 2 min cooldown This spell belongs to Knight of Xoroth    Enter your Hellfire Form, increasing your Fire damage dealt by 10% and Fire critical strike chance by 10% for 20 sec.

Name: Hemal Excision
Description: Teaches you: Hemal Excision    Hemal Excision 30 yd range 1.5 min cooldown 20 Health 1 sec cast This spell belongs to Bloodmage    Cut into an ally's vital essence, siphoning all curse effects from them. You may reactivate this ability again within 10 sec to place these curse effects on an enemy.

Name: Here Comes The Big One
Description: Every fourth use of Bloodthirst now deals 150% increased damage.

Name: Heretic of Gul'dan
Description: Dealing damage with spells reduces the cooldown of Hand of Gul'Dan by 0.5 sec.  This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

Name: Higher Power
Description: Increases the amount healed by Greater Heal by 20%, but increases its mana cost by 40%.

Name: Hippocratic Oath
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Increases your healing power by 20% of your attack power.

Name: Hoarfrost
Description: Teaches you: Hoarfrost    Hoarfrost 10 sec cooldown 8 Mana This spell belongs to Runemaster    Slash in a frozen fury in front of you, dealing 8 Frost Damage to up to 3 nearby enemies, plus an additional 8 every 3 sec for 21 sec.     Enemies hit by the initial strike are frozen in place for 3 sec.

Name: Holy Ascension
Description: Requires  Surge of Light (Rank 2)  Periodic damage of your Holy Fire now has a 15% chance to trigger Surge of Light.    Instant Smites now grant Ascended.    Ascended Increases the holy critical strike chance by 1%. Stacks up to 10. Lasts 15 seconds.    Surge of Light Your next Smite or Flash Heal is instant and costs no mana. It cannot critically hit. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Holy Ground
Description: Allies within your Consecration receive 5% additional healing from you.    Your Direct Heals on allies within Consecration radiate to 5 nearby allies for 5% of the healing done.    Does not trigger from Purification by Light's or Consecrated Strikes's Consecration effect.

Name: Holy Radiance
Description: Your Greater Heal and Flash Heal now trigger Holy Radiance on all allies affected by your Renew.    Holy Radiance Heals for 30% of the healing done by your Greater Heal or 40% of the healing done by your Flash Heal.

Name: Holy Shatter
Description: Critical strikes with Frost spells and abilities mark your target.    Critical strikes with Holy spells and abilities shatter the mark, dealing 43 Holyfrost damage to 8 nearby enemies.    Marks stack up to 5 and increase the damage the target takes from Holy Shatter by 20%. Lasts 12 seconds.    Scales with Cone of Cold modifiers.

Name: Holy Spirit
Description: Healing or dealing damage with Penance grants you Holy Spirit.      Holy Spirit Increases the critical strike chance and healing of your next Holy Shock by 20%. Stacks 4 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Holy Water Tonic
Description: Teaches you: Holy Water Tonic    Holy Water Tonic 3 min cooldown 50 Rage This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Smash a holy water tonic beneath you, stunning all Undead and Demon enemies within 8 yds for 6 sec and increasing your damage dealt against Undead and Demons by 15% for 20 sec.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Hot Hands
Description: Pyroblast and Arctis can now trigger Hot Streak.

Name: Hydra's Sting
Description: Dealing damage with Serpent Sting reduces the cooldown of Rapid Fire by 3 sec.

Name: Hydromancer
Description: Dealing damage with Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt and Frost Nova applies Doused.  Water Nova summons a tidal pool for 6 sec, applying Doused to enemies that remain inside.    Doused Taking damage from Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning triggers Electrocute.   Electrocute Deals 6 Froststorm damage and incapacitates the target for 2 seconds.  The same enemy can only be incapacitated once every 30 sec.

Name: I'm a Fan of Knives
Description: Dealing damage with Shuriken Toss and Deadly Throw has a 35% chance to increase the damage of your next Fan of Knives by 35% and its critical strike chance by 35%. Max 3 charges.

Name: Ice Barrage
Description: Dealing damage with Cone of Cold, Deep Freeze, Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt and Ray of Frost grants you an Icicle that stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 20 sec.  Dealing damage with Ice Lance rapidly launches your stored Icicles at the target, dealing 407 Frost damage.  You cannot gain Icicles while they are launching.

Name: Icecrown Double-Tap
Description: Direct Frost spell damage has an 25% chance to grant Icecrown Double-Tap.      Icecrown Double-Tap Allows your next Kill Shot to be used regardless of the target's health. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Icy Onslaught
Description: Icy Touch against a target affected by your Blood Plague empowers your next Rune Strike. Rune Strike deals 100% increased damage and reduces all damage you take by 8% for 6 sec.

Name: Ignis Ultimatus
Description: Teaches you: Ignis Ultimatus    Ignis Ultimatus 50 yd range 1 min cooldown 12 Mana This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Channel for 2 sec, gathering a surge of fiery power before unleashing it in a 50 yd line, dealing 400 Fire damage to enemies while also healing allies for 300.    Ignores invulnerabilities, immunities, and resistances.

Name: Illuminated Judgement
Description: Your Infusion of Light now grants Illuminated Judgement      Illuminated Judgement Your next Judgement spell deals 100% increased damage (30% against players) but has a 1.5 second cast time.

Name: Impeccable Timing
Description: Requires  Missile Barrage (Rank 3)  Your mastery of time grants you Impeccable Timing every 10 seconds.    Impeccable Timing Your Arcane Blast, Starfire, Starsurge, Arcane Barrage, Fireball, Frostbolt, Slow, Frostfire Bolt, Moonfire, or Arcane Orb grants you Missile Barrage. Lasts 3 sec.    Missile Barrage Reduces the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 2.5 sec, reduces the mana cost by 100%, and the missiles fire every 0.4 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Impending Doom
Description: Your Death and Decay, Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death now apply Impending Doom.    Impending Doom Your next 5 periodic Shadow damage hits deal 25% increased damage.

Name: Imposing Combo
Description: Empowers these abilities to now consume combo points, increasing their threat and granting you a buff for 2 seconds plus an additional 2 seconds per combo point:    - Divine Storm increases your armor by 25%.  - Victory Rush increases your max health by 10%.  - Stormstrike reduces your damage taken by 6%.

Name: In For the Kill
Description: Increases the duration of Rend by 6 seconds, and your Mortal Strike refreshes the duration of your Rend.

Name: In Sword We Trust
Description: Casting Slam now grants you In Sword We Trust.    In Sword We Trust Increases your next Crusader Strike's damage and critical strike chance by 35%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 8 sec.

Name: In the Zone
Description: Dealing damage with Unfair Advantage now grants you a shield that absorbs magic damage.    This effect can only occur once every 4 sec.

Name: Incarnation of Chaos
Description: Teaches you: Incarnation of Chaos    Incarnation of Chaos 3 min cooldown 14 Mana This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Every 2 sec, gain a stack of Incarnation of Chaos, increasing all damage you deal by 2%, stacking up to 10 times.

Name: Incessant Screams
Description: Psychic Scream creates a shadowy image of you at your location. After 4 sec, the image will let out a Psychic Scream.

Name: Inducing Trauma
Description: Your Backstab, Mutilate and Ambush extend the duration of your Rend by 2 sec.

Name: Inevitable Vengeance
Description: Your Seal of Vengeance damage over time now benefits from your haste and can now critically strike.  Your Seal of Vengeance damage over time effect also causes the target to take 1% more Physical and Holy damage per stack.

Name: Inferno Barrier
Description: Teaches you: Inferno Barrier    Inferno Barrier 20 sec cooldown 18 Mana This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Engulf an ally with molten power for 30 sec. While active, attackers take 6 Fire damage each time they deal damage to them.    Scales with Spirit.

Name: Infinite Burn
Description: Dealing damage with Chaos Bolt, Incinerate, Searing Pain, and Scorch now grants you Infinite Burn.     Infinite Burn Your next Conflagrate does not consume Immolate. Lasts for 10 sec.

Name: Infused Aegis
Description: Teaches you: Infused Aegis    Infused Aegis 30 sec cooldown This spell belongs to Starcaller    Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you from the front in melee for Arcane damage, lasting 10 sec. Can only occur once per sec per enemy.

Name: Insatiable
Description: Your Taste for Blood now stacks up to 3 times and increases your next Overpower's damage by an additional 15%.

Name: Jagged Reinforcement
Description: Teaches you: Jagged Reinforcement    Jagged Reinforcement 2 sec cast This spell belongs to Guardian    Reinforce your shield with razor edges, increasing your critical damage bonus by 4% Lasts 1 hr.

Name: Judged Infection
Description: Dealing damage with a Judgement increases the damage the target takes from your Blood Plague by 20% for 15 seconds.

Name: Judged Retaliation
Description: Your Judgements have a 50% chance to allow the use of Counterattack for 10 seconds and reset its cooldown.

Name: Judgement of Mercy
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Your Holy abilities and heals have a 25% chance to cause your next Judgement to heal 5 nearby allies within 40 yards of the target.    Judgement of Mercy's healing scales with Judgement damage modifiers.    Does not work while Seal of Fervor is active.

Name: Judgement of The Three Hammers
Description: Teaches you: Judgement of The Three Hammers    Judgement of The Three Hammers 2 min cooldown 7 Mana This spell belongs to Primalist    While active, dealing direct damage with spells and abilities has a 20% chance to hurl 3 hammers over 2 sec, each dealing 103 Physical damage. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Knight of the Eclipse
Description: Dealing damage with Sinister Strike, Slam, or Whirlwind grants you Knight of the Eclipse.      Knight of the Eclipse Reduces the cast time of your next Wrath, Starfire or Starsurge by 50% and increases its damage by 15%. Against monsters, these spells deal an additional 20% damage per stack.  Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Lava Freeze
Description: Dealing damage with Lava Lash now grants you Solid Ice.     Solid Ice Increases the damage of Ice Lance, Cone of Cold, Frostbolt and Deep Freeze by 8%. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Lava Surge
Description: Flame Shock damage over time has a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Lava Burst.

Name: Leader of the Elements
Description: Dealing damage with Stormstrike or Lava Lash reduces the cooldown of your Greater Elemental Totems by 10 seconds.  Casting Shaman Shocks or Elemental Blast grants your Greater Elementals and Tether Elemental Leader of the Elements. This effect can only occur once every 20 sec from the same spell.   Leader of the Elements Increases the damage your Greater Elementals deal by 30% and your Tethered Elemental does by 15%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Legacy of the Arcanist
Description: Dealing direct damage with Arcane, Fire, Frost, and Nature empowers your next Meteor cast with its own element.  Casting Meteor unleashes the stored elements, causing 185 damage to the target and up to 2 additional targets.  |nWhen casting spells involving multiple elements, only the Meteor corresponding to the first element in the order of Fire, Nature, Frost, and Arcane will trigger.

Name: Lich Form
Description: Teaches you: Lich Form    Lich Form 3 min cooldown This spell belongs to Necromancer    Transform into a lich for 30 sec, increasing Frost damage you deal by 10%.

Name: Lich's Calling
Description: Dealing damage with Cone of Cold, Deep Freeze or Howling Blast afflicts your target with Lich's Calling.      Lich's Calling Increase the effectiveness of your Frost periodic effects on the target by 30%. Has 8 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Lichplague
Description: Teaches you: Lichplague    Lichplague 30 yd range 30 sec cooldown 30 Rage 1.5 sec cast This spell belongs to Necromancer    Disease an enemy, dealing 26 Plague damage every 3 sec for 18 sec.    Damage increased by 20% for each of your diseases on the enemy.

Name: Lifeblood
Description: Teaches you: Lifeblood    Lifeblood 3 min cooldown 20 Mana This spell belongs to Venomancer    Embrace Shadra's lifeblood, reducing your damage taken and pushback from casting spells by 20% and causing all damage taken to cast Rejuvenating Venom. Lasts for 10 sec.  Rejuvenating Venom Heal a random ally within 30 yds of your target for 2 over 6 sec.

Name: Light of Life
Description: Halo heals allies hit for 3 every 2 sec for 6 sec and extends the duration of Renew by 6 sec.    Direct Holy heals reduce the cooldown of Halo by 2 sec.    Renew cannot be extended past its maximum duration.

Name: Lightning Rod
Description: Requires  Path of Healing Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt now applies Lightning Rod and your Living Lightning critical strikes and healing grant you charges of Living Lightning Rod.    Lightning Rod Critically healing an ally with a direct Nature heal strikes your Lightning Rod with a Lightning Bolt.    Only one target can be affected by Lightning Rod at a time. This effect cannot trigger from periodic, or channeled spells.   Living Lightning Rod Increases the damage of your next Lightning Bolt or Lightning Rod strike by 100%. Stores up to 5 charges and lasts for 12 sec.    Living Lightning can grant multiple charges per cast.

Name: Lightning Strikes Twice
Description: Removes the cooldown on Chain Lightning, but reduces its damage dealt by 10%.

Name: Locust Resurgence
Description: Casting Steady Shot now reduces the cooldown of Chimera Shot by 1 seconds.

Name: Low Tide
Description: Increases your chance to critically heal your Riptide target with Nature spells by 20%.

Name: Lunar Explosion
Description: Periodic Moonfire damage has a 10% chance to grant you Lunar Explosion.    Lunar Explosion Your next Arcane Explosion has 100% increased critical strike chance.

Name: Lunar Frenzy
Description: Requires  Owlkin Frenzy (Rank 3)  Entering Lunar or Solar Eclipse now grants you Owlkin Frenzy.    Owlkin Frenzy While in Moonkin Form, attacks against you have an 8% chance to trigger a Frenzy, increasing your damage done by 5%.     This also grants immunity to casting pushback for Balance spells and restores 2% base mana every 2 sec. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Lunar Marksmanship
Description: During Eclipse (Lunar), Arcane Shot has 50% reduced cooldown and has 30% increased critical strike chance.

Name: Lunar Spirits
Description: Your Arcane Missile strikes against enemies affected by your Moonfire unleash Lunar Spirits on 5 nearby enemies within 10 yards.      Lunar Spirits Burns the enemy for 9 Arcane damage every 3 for 9 sec.

Name: Macro-Gravity Zone
Description: Teaches you: Macro-Gravity Zone    Macro-Gravity Zone 20 yd range 1.5 min cooldown 13 Mana This spell belongs to Tinker    Create a macro-gravity zone at target location for 8 sec.    Enemies within the zone have their movement speed slowed by 40% and gain 1 stack of Macro-Gravity every 0.50 sec.  Macro-Gravity At 6 stacks, you will be stunned for 6 sec.

Name: Magical Ammunition
Description: Damaging spells grant you Magical Ammunition.      Magical Ammunition Increases the amount of your next Multi-Shot projectiles by 1. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Malediction
Description: Teaches you: Malediction    Malediction 30 yd range 30 sec cooldown 25 Rage This spell belongs to Bloodmage    Condemn an enemy, dealing 201 Shadow damage over 12 sec and increasing the damage they take from the next 5 direct damage spells dealt by you, your pets, or your guardians by 20%.

Name: Maledictive Assault
Description: Requires  Bear Form (Shapeshift) While Nightfall or Backlash is active, your Shadow Bolt can be cast while in Bear Form and hits two additional targets for reduced damage.

Name: Mana Leech
Description: Your Mana Burn eliminates 30% more mana, but deals 30% less damage, with a 30% higher mana cost and an additional 8 second cooldown.

Name: March of the Dead
Description: Teaches you: March of the Dead    March of the Dead 30 sec cooldown 40 Rage This spell belongs to Necromancer    Spend rage to summon a line of undead at the target location for 30 sec.    Each undead marches forward, exploding when it reaches an enemy and dealing damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Martial Crescendo
