Each enemy hit by Shadow Crash will be made vulnerable increasing the damage they take from the caster's Shadow Bolt, Shadow Burn and Chaos Bolt by 10%.

Name: Shadow of Death
Description: Casting Shadowstep now empowers your next Ambush or Ravage, causing them to deal an additional 75% as Shadow damage.

Name: Shadow Visions
Description: Dealing damage with Mind Flay now grants you a Soul Fragment. After accumulating 6 fragments you gain Shadow Visions.      Shadow Visions Empowers your next ability:  - Devouring Plague: Lasts for 12 more seconds, and causes a shadowy explosion.  - Vampiric Touch: Causes you to deal 20% increased Shadow damage to the target for 15 sec.  - Mind Blast: Deals 50% increased damage and grants you Psychic Surge, increasing the damage of Mind Flay and Mind Sear by 25%. This bonus is reduced by 1% for each time they deal damage.

Name: Shadowcrawl
Description: Teaches you: Shadowcrawl    Shadowcrawl 3 min cooldown 28 Mana This spell belongs to Venomancer    For 15 sec, all periodic damage dealt now has a 30% chance to burst dealing 10% of its damage as Shadow damage to 8 enemies within 8 yds.    Usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Sharpened Blade
Description: Dealing damage with Deadly Bite now has a 50% chance to grant you Sharpened Blade.      Sharpened Blade Reduces the active cooldown of Savage Blade and Glaive Toss by 2 sec and increases the damage of your next Savage Blade by 15% against monsters. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 12 sec.    Savage Blade deals 10% increased damage against players.

Name: Shield of the Emperor
Description: Your Shield Slam and Shield of Righteousness now have a 25% chance to grant a stack of Shield of the Emperor, and extend the duration of Avatar by 4 sec if it is active.    Shield of the Emperor Increases the duration of your next Avatar by 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Shields of Dominance
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Power Word: Shield by 2 seconds.

Name: Shieldsmasher
Description: Your Counterattack, Savage Blade and Execute grant you Shield Smasher.    Shieldsmasher Increases the damage of your next Colossus Smash by 65% and extends its duration by 3 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 20 sec.    Increases damage versus players by 10%.

Name: Shooting Stars
Description: While Starfall is active, the duration is increased by half of the cast time of your Spells.    Channeled spells do not extend the duration.

Name: Shot Weaving
Description: Casting Arcane Missiles while Missile Barrage is active weaves shot and spell together, firing a ranged shot with each Arcane Missile, dealing 15 Physical damage.    While in Path of Agility or Duality your Missile Barrage is hastened by 60%.    Gunslinger's Barrage can trigger Piercing Shots (if known).

Name: Shoulder The Burden
Description: Teaches you: Shoulder The Burden    Shoulder The Burden 30 yd range 1 min cooldown This spell belongs to Guardian    Instantly transfers 50% of the ally target's threat to you.

Name: Sinister Flurry
Description: Your Sinister Strike has a 50% chance to trigger an additional strike, dealing 130% weapon damage and awarding an additional combo point.

Name: Sinister Transfusion
Description: Dealing damage with combo point generating abilities now grants your Tamed Pet Sinister Transfusion.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.    Sinister Transfusion Increases your Tamed Pet's damage by 20% and restores 1% total mana, 10 energy and Focus every 2 sec for 8 sec.

Name: Skeleton King
Description: Death Pact no longer sacrifices its undead minion.    While in Frost Presence, casting Death Pact while Bone Shield is active restores all Bone Shield charges and increases your maximum health by 15%. The maximum health increase lasts until Bone Shield fades.

Name: Smoldering Companion
Description: Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks now deal Fire damage.    Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks can only be transformed to one damage type at once.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Snapseed
Description: Teaches you: Snapseed    Snapseed 20 sec cooldown 35 Energy This spell belongs to Ranger    Toss a snapseed at an enemy, dealing 37 Physical damage and knocking them back.

Name: Snatch
Description: Teaches you: Snatch    Snatch 45 sec cooldown 40 Energy This spell belongs to Ranger    Snatch an enemy's melee weapons, disarming them for 4 sec.    If you are disarmed, you also return your weapon to yourself.

Name: Solar Fury
Description: Casting Starfire and Starsurge during Eclipse (Lunar) grants Solar Fury.      Solar Fury During Eclipse (Solar) your next Wrath deals 50% more damage and reduces the cooldown of Eclipse Blast by 1 sec.    Lasts for 20 sec. Can hold up to 5 charges.

Name: Solar Nova
Description: Teaches you: Solar Nova    Solar Nova 20 sec cooldown 20 Mana This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Emit a powerful holy light in an 8 yd radius, dealing 94 Holy damage to all nearby enemies.     This ability is guaranteed to critically strike against Undead or Demons.

Name: Soul Restoration
Description: Casting Holy Light, Greater Heal, Healing Wave, or Healing Touch on an ally reduces the duration of their Weakened Soul by 2 seconds.

Name: Southpaw Strike
Description: Using Bloodthirst, Execute or Rend triggers an instant off-hand attack, dealing 220% weapon damage, and grants you Southpaw.   Southpaw Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25% for 9 sec.    The effect of Southpaw is increased to 50% while only Single-Minded Fury is active. This effect can only occur once every 16 sec and Southpaw cannot be active at the same time as Dominant.

Name: Spectral Warden
Description: Teaches you: Spectral Warden    Spectral Warden 3 min cooldown 20 Rage This spell belongs to Reaper    Summon a spectral guardian to fight alongside you for 20 sec and apply an absorption shield to up to 8 allies within 20 yds, absorbing 235 damage.

Name: Speed Rune
Description: Teaches you: Speed Rune    Speed Rune 2 min cooldown 11 Mana This spell belongs to Runemaster    Conjure a path of runes in the direction you are facing for 10 sec, increasing the movement speed of allies by 70%.    This effect can persist for a short duration after leaving the runic path.

Name: Spell Slinger
Description: When Arcane Clearcasting is consumed, an Arcane Burst deals 6 Arcane damage to your target.

Name: Spellstorm
Description: When Missile Barrage is consumed by Arcane Missiles, you gain Arcane Evoked.    When Brain Freeze is consumed by Fireball or Frostfire Bolt, you gain Fire Evoked.      Arcane Evoked Increases the chance to trigger your next Brain Freeze by an additional 80%. Lasts for 10 sec.    Fire Evoked Increases the chance to trigger your next Missile Barrage by an additional 80%. Lasts for 10 sec.

Name: Spiked Reinforcement
Description: Teaches you: Spiked Reinforcement    Spiked Reinforcement 2 sec cast This spell belongs to Guardian    Reinforce your shield with spikes, causing your blocks to deal 3 Physical damage to the attacker. Lasts 1 hour.

Name: Spirit Frost
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Every other cast of Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt or Ice Lance grants you Spirit Frost.       Spirit Frost Greater Heal reduces its cast time by 100% and Prayer of Healing reduces its cast time by 50%.     Can hold up to 5 charges and lasts 20 sec.

Name: Spirited Penance
Description: Increases the channel time of Penance by 25% to empower it to fire an additional bolt.

Name: Splintered Chaos
Description: Casting Conflagrate now grants you Splintered Chaos    Splintered Chaos Your Chaos Bolt hits 4 additional nearby enemies.

Name: Spore
Description: Teaches you: Spore    Spore 30 yd range 12 Mana 1.5 sec cast This spell belongs to Venomancer    Inject an enemy with parasitic spores, dealing 15 Shadow damage, plus an additional 84 to 98 over 21 sec.    After 10 sec, drop a Mushroom below the target that explodes after 2 sec, dealing 2 Nature damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Spot Weakness
Description: Direct damage spell and abilities have a 15% chance to grant you Spot Weakness.      Spot Weakness Allows Kill Shot to be used regardless of the target's health.

Name: Spreading Roots
Description: Your Mass Entanglement now spreads to nearby enemies every 3 sec. These roots last 3 sec and also spread to nearby enemies.  An enemy can only be affected by Spreading Roots once every 10 sec.

Name: Spreading Tides
Description: Critically healing your Riptide target with Healing Wave now casts Riptide to a nearby ally within 15 yards. Only casts on effective heals.    Prioritizes your ally with the lowest health and can target the ally being healed to refresh their Riptide.

Name: Stalker of the Frozen Wastes
Description: Ranged Hunter abilities have a 40% chance to reduce the active cooldown of Frozen Orb by 8 sec.  Casting Frozen Orb increases your ranged haste by 30% for 30 sec.

Name: Starcall
Description: Teaches you: Starcall    Starcall 20 sec cooldown 8 Mana This spell belongs to Starcaller    Smash up to 8 enemies, dealing 4 Arcane damage, scaling with block value, and reducing their attack speed by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Starshatter
Description: Teaches you: Starshatter    Starshatter 1.5 min cooldown 4 Mana This spell belongs to Starcaller    Call down the power of the stars, sending forth Elune's astral light in a line outward from you, stunning enemies struck for 5 sec.

Name: Stay Frosty
Description: Casting damaging spells or dealing damage with Auto Shot increases the chance to trigger Fingers of Frost by 3% for 10 sec or until activated.

Name: Steed of Glory
Description: Your Divine Steed lasts for an additional 3 sec. While active, you become immune to movement impairing effects.    For each unique enemy you pass through with Divine Steed, the duration of your next Avenging Wrath increases by 0.5 second. Up to 10 seconds.

Name: Stellar Amplification
Description: Dealing damage with Starsurge now apply Stellar Amplification.    Stellar Amplification Your next 5 Balance Druid periodic hits deal 30% increased damage.

Name: Storm of Darkness
Description: Each target damaged by Shadowfury reduces the remaining cooldown of Bladestorm by 4 sec.

Name: Stormborn
Description: While Elemental Mastery or Shamanistic Rage is active, dealing damage with Stormstrike now deals an additional 86 Nature damage to all enemies in front of you.

Name: Stormcloak
Description: Teaches you: Stormcloak    Stormcloak 2 min cooldown 8 Mana This spell belongs to Stormbringer    Cover yourself in a barrier of volatile energy for 15 sec, causing all attacks against you to have a 25% chance to deal half damage.    Stormcloak has a 60% chance to resist dispel effects.

Name: Stormforged Edge
Description: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Static Shock and Thunderstorm hits increase the damage of your next Stormstrike by 24%. Stacks up to 8. Lasts 8 sec. Duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Stormgarde
Description: While Lightning Shield is active, your Shield Slam and Shield of Righteousness now unleash Stormgarde.    Stormgarde Zaps your target and 2 nearby enemies for 26 Nature damage and restores your Lightning Shield charges.    This uses Lightning Shield modifiers and can only occur once every 2 sec.

Name: Stupefied
Description: Shield Bash now reduces the enemy's cast speed by 30% for 6 sec.    This effect does not stack with other similar effects

Name: Sun Down
Description: Teaches you: Sun Down    Sun Down 30 yd range 30 sec cooldown 20 Mana This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Bring the wrath of the sun down upon an enemy after 2 sec, dealing 352 Holyflame Damage and scorching the earth beneath them for 9 sec.    While inside, enemies are struck by a Solar Flare every 3 sec.  Solar Flare Deals 40 Holyflame Damage and reduces the target's chance to hit by 3% for 10 sec.

Name: Sunwell
Description: Teaches you: Sunwell    Sunwell 3 min cooldown 9 Mana This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Become an embodiment of the sun for 30 sec, periodically dispelling fear, sleep, and charm effects every 3 sec from allies within 40 yds.

Name: Surging Shadows
Description: Dealing Shadow periodic damage has a 10% chance to grant Surging Shadows, increasing your Lightning Overload chance by 40% for 10 sec.

Name: Surging Tonic
Description: Teaches you: Surging Tonic    Surging Tonic 3 min cooldown 50 Rage This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Drink a bitter tonic, increasing your haste by 15% and reducing the cost of all abilities by 20% for 15 sec.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Survival Potion
Description: Teaches you: Survival Potion    Survival Potion 2 min cooldown 0 Focus This spell belongs to Ranger    Drink a survival potion, immediately dispelling all poison and disease effects. Every 3 sec for 9 sec, heal for 10% of your maximum health and remove one additional poison and disease effect.

Name: Swashbuckler: Bloodsail
Description: Requires  Duelist's Glove  A Duelist's Glove is an off-hand item that enables Swashbuckling. It is granted whenever you learn a talent or ability that requires it. Requires a one-handed weapon and does not work while shapeshifted.    Your Finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Bloodsail Swashbuckler.    Does not work while shapeshifted.      Bloodsail Swashbuckling Your critical chance is increased by 2%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 12 seconds.

Name: Swashbuckler: Flurry of Blows
Description: Requires  Duelist's Glove  A Duelist's Glove is an off-hand item that enables Swashbuckling. It is granted whenever you learn a talent or ability that requires it. Requires a one-handed weapon and does not work while shapeshifted.    Increase your melee haste by 30% while Swashbuckling.    Does not work while shapeshifted

Name: Swashbuckler: Matched Blows
Description: Requires  Duelist's Glove  A Duelist's Glove is an off-hand item that enables Swashbuckling. It is granted whenever you learn a talent or ability that requires it. Requires a one-handed weapon and does not work while shapeshifted.    Increases your chance to parry by 5% while Swashbuckling.    Does not work while shapeshifted

Name: Swashbuckler: Shocktrooper
Description: Requires  Duelist's Glove  A Duelist's Glove is an off-hand item that enables Swashbuckling. It is granted whenever you learn a talent or ability that requires it. Requires a one-handed weapon and does not work while shapeshifted.    Reduces the cooldowns of your Shaman Shock spells by 2 seconds while Swashbuckling.    Does not work while shapeshifted

Name: Swashbuckling Duelist
Description: Requires  Duelist's Glove  A Duelist's Glove is an off-hand item that enables Swashbuckling. It is granted whenever you learn a talent or ability that requires it. Requires a one-handed weapon and does not work while shapeshifted.    Sinister Strike now grants you Swashbuckling Duelist for 12 seconds, causing your next Mongoose Bite to unleash a Pirate's Flurry.    Pirate's Flurry You unleash a flurry of blows, striking your target for 225% weapon damage 3 times over 1 second.

Name: Swift Avenger
Description: Your Avenger's Shield now hits up to 3 additional targets. For each target hit, you gain 10% increased movement speed. Stacks up to 6 times and lasts 4 sec.

Name: Swift Shadows
Description: Increases the duration of your Shadowstep by 2 seconds.    Ambushing, Deadly Throwing or Ravaging a Shadow Marked target resets the cooldown of your Shadowstep.

Name: Sword and Thunder
Description: Your Devastate and Revenge now have a 30% chance to grant you Sword and Thunder and reset Thunder Clap's cooldown.    Sword and Thunder Your next Thunder Clap costs no rage. Lasts for 5 sec.

Name: Synergetic Light
Description: Holy Light and Flash of Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Shock by 2 seconds.

Name: Tainted Swipe
Description: Every 10 seconds, you now gain Tainted Swipe.    Tainted Swipe Your next Swipe infects targets hit, dealing 5 Plague damage every 2 seconds for 10 sec.

Name: Talonshrike
Description: Raptor Strike, Counterattack and Mongoose Bite deal 30% increased damage.    Using Raptor Strike reduces the cooldown of Fury of the Eagle by 4 sec.    Requires wielding a single two-handed weapon.

Name: Teachings of Arugal
Description: Requires  Missile Barrage (Rank 3)  Shadow spells with a cast time grant you Arugal's Fury and have a 30% chance to grant Missile Barrage.    Arugal's Fury Increases the damage of your next Arcane Missile by 40% and critical strike by 10%. Store up to 10 charges and lasts for 12 sec.    Missile Barrage Reduces the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 2.5 sec, reduces the mana cost by 100%, and the missiles fire every 0.4 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Tempered by Chaos
Description: Consuming Molten Core with Incinerate or Chaos Bolt resets the cooldown of Fel Cleave and increases the damage of your next Fel Cleave by 30%.

Name: Templar of Flame
Description: Your Judgements now grant you Templar of Flame.    Templar of Flame Dealing direct damage with Flamestrike now reduces the cooldown of Blast Wave and Dragon's Breath by 1 sec. Lasts for 6 sec.

Name: Temporal Distortion
Description: Your Align, Synchronize and Time-Bind now grant you Temporal Distortion.    Temporal Distortion Reduces your energy generation by 10%.    Increases the duration of Eternity by 0.4 sec and its healing by 13%. Stacks up to 20 times and lasts for 30 sec or until you reach 0 energy.

Name: Testament of Fortitude
Description: Teaches you: Testament of Fortitude    Testament of Fortitude 3 min cooldown 20 Energy This spell belongs to Templar    Meditate for 15 sec, restoring 5% of your base health every 1 sec and reducing damage taken by 20%.    Each second you will also remove 1 disease effect from yourself.

Name: Tethered Power
Description: Your Tethered Elemental's critical strikes now grant you Elemental Air.    Elemental Air Your next Elemental Blast has its critical strike chance, critical strike damage bonus, and damage against monsters increased by 30%.

Name: The Shattering
Description: Your Shattering Throw now triggers an Earthquake beneath the enemy for 4 sec.

Name: Thunder Seer
Description: Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning grant Thunder Seer.     Thunder Seer Increases the damage of the next Arcane Missiles projectile by 40%. Holds up to 25 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Thunder Stomp
Description: Slam and Stormstrike now reduce the active cooldown of Thunder Clap by 2 seconds.

Name: Thundering Blow
Description: When Shockwave hits an enemy affected by your Thunder Clap it unleashes an additional Nature strike for 25% of the damage dealt. Reduces the cooldown of Shockwave for each enemy hit by this additional strike by 1 second, up to 10 seconds.

Name: Tidecaller's Boon
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Your Healing Wave heals for 50% more and applies 3 stacks of Tidecaller's Boon.    Tidecaller's Boon Receives 4% reduced healing from your Healing Wave.    Your periodic healing removes one stack. Stacks up to 15 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Tidecaller's Grace
Description: Your Tidecaller's Boon now increases your periodic healing on the target by 30% per stack.

Name: Tides of Battle
Description: Sinister Strike now grants you Ebb when used above 90% energy and Flow when used below 90% energy.    These effects cannot be active at the same time.    Ebb Increases your Physical damage by 4%, but drains 3% maximum energy per second. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 5 sec.    Flow Increases your Energy regeneration by 15%, but reduces your attack speed by 2%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 5 sec.

Name: Tidewaters
Description: While in combat, casting Renew, Rejuvenation or Riptide now grants you Tidewaters.     This effect can only occur from the same ally once every 8 seconds.      Tidewaters Increases the healing of your Healing Rain by 30% and reduces its cast time by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 8 sec.

Name: TIMBERRR
Description: Increases treants summoned by your Force of Nature by 3.    When used with Guardians of the Grove, reduces their healing done by 20%.

Name: Time Out!
Description: Teaches you: Time Out!    Time Out! 3 min cooldown This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Enter a stasis for 6 sec, instantly restoring 15% of your maximum mana and regenerating 5% of your maximum mana every 0.50 sec.  While active, your damage taken is reduced by 50% but any direct damage taken may end the effect.

Name: Timeguard
Description: Teaches you: Timeguard    Timeguard 30 yd range 2 min cooldown 24 Mana This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Place a magical guard on an ally for 2 min, causing the next 3 instances of direct damage that would reduce the target below 35% health to deal 40% less damage.

Name: Titan's Fury
Description: Using Titanic Strike grants Titan's Fury.      Titan's Fury Increases your melee attack speed by 150% but burns all your rage, energy and runes for 4 seconds.    This can not occur more than once every 12 seconds

Name: Tools of War
Description: Each unique direct damage Physical ability now grants you Tools of War.      Tools of War Increases Physical damage dealt by 3%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 8 sec. Dealing magic damage resets all stacks. The duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Toss and Throw
Description: Using Deadly Throw causes your next three casts of Shuriken Toss or Glaive Toss to generate an additional combo point, cost 20% fewer resources and deal 70% more damage against monsters. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Total Lunar Eclipse
Description: Lunar Eclipse now increases your Arcane damage by 20%.

Name: Total Solar Eclipse
Description: Solar Eclipse also increases your critical chance with Nature spells by 20%.

Name: Totemic Avatar
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Greater Elemental Totems by 50%.

Name: Toxic Strikes
Description: Dealing damage with Instant Poison grants you Toxic Strikes.    Critical strikes with Instant Poison grant you Hydra's Fang.      Toxic Strikes Slam, Overpower and Mortal Strike consume your Toxic Strikes stacks to deal 10% increased damage per stack. Stacks up to 10 times. Lasts 12 sec.    Hydra's Fang Slam, Overpower and Mortal Strike consume 3 stacks to deal 4 additional Nature damage. Stacks up to 12 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Tracer Augmentation
Description: Teaches you: Tracer Augmentation    Tracer Augmentation This spell belongs to Tinker    Add a Tracer Augmentation to your gun for 1 hour, causing your ranged auto attacks to deal an additional 5% weapon damage as Fire damage.

Name: Transcendental Embrace
Description: Critical healing with Lesser Healing Wave, Healing Wave, Regrowth, and Healing Touch now grant you Transcendental Embrace.      Transcendental Embrace Your next Chain Heal has 10% increased critical strike chance, 15% reduced cast time, and jumps to an additional ally. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 20 sec.

Name: Trauma Care
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Trauma Care.    Trauma Care Makes your next Greater Heal instant. Can hold up to 2 charges and lasts for 16 sec.

Name: Trick Shots
Description: Multi-Shot now grants you Trick Shot when hitting 3 or more targets.      Trick Shot Your next Aimed Shot, Kill Shot or Arcane Shot ricochets to 5 nearby enemies, losing momentum with every target hit. Lasts for 6 sec.

Name: Twilight Eruption
Description: Dealing damage with Mind Blast or Haunt reduces the remaining cooldown of Lava Burst by 1 sec. Dealing damage with Lava Burst extends your Unstable Affliction and Vampiric Touch on the target by 1 sec.

Name: Twilight Paragon
Description: Exorcism now consumes Paragon of Light to trigger Twilight Treason, increasing its damage by 15% per stack and transforms you into a Paragon of Darkness for 1 second per stack.      Twilight Treason Deals 62 Twilight damage to the target.    Paragon of Darkness Your Mind Flay, Mind Sear and Penance torment the target, dealing 43 additional Twilight damage. In addition, you gain 10% spell critical strike chance.

Name: Twilight Shieldtoss
Description: Teaches you: Twilight Shieldtoss    Twilight Shieldtoss 30 yd range 8 sec cooldown 12 Mana This spell belongs to Cultist    Hurl a cursed shield, dealing 72 Shadow damage to up to 3 enemies, reduced by 20% with each jump.

Name: Twisted Seal
Description: Teaches you: Twisted Seal    Twisted Seal 100 yd range 2 min cooldown 21 Mana This spell belongs to Cultist    Create a warped sigil that bends hostile force away from you, deflecting all spells for 5 sec, but making you unable to attack or cast spells.    Casters whose magic is deflected are silenced for 3 sec.

Name: Umbral Wounds
Description: While in Shadowform, your Deep Wounds deal Shadowstrike damage but no longer a bleed.

Name: Unchained
Description: Your Blink now slows nearby enemies by 50% for 2 sec.

Name: Undaunted
Description: Your Last Stand now sacrifices 5% of its maximum health granted to remove your Stagger debuff, clearing all stored damage.

Name: Unstable Chronoglass
Description: Teaches you: Unstable Chronoglass    Unstable Chronoglass 20 yd range 1 min cooldown 22 Mana This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Place an Unstable Chronoglass at target location for 30 sec that will redirect the next 3 enemy spell casts onto itself.

Name: Ursine Frenzy
Description: Dealing damage with Thrash and Lacerate has a 10% chance to grant you Ursine Frenzy.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.      Ursine Frenzy Increases the damage of Mangle (Bear) by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 5 sec.    While Ursine Frenzy is active Mangle (Bear) has no cooldown and generates more stacks, but will not extend the duration.

Name: Ursoc's Blessing
Description: Bear Form's bonus Stamina and Armor persists for 3 seconds after leaving Bear Form.

Name: Ursoc's Rage
Description: Using Maul, Mangle or Lacerate reduces the cooldown of Enrage by 2 seconds. Enrage also reduces the rage cost of Ironfur by 50%.

Name: Valkyr's Calling
Description: Teaches you: Valkyr's Calling    Valkyr's Calling 20 yd range 3 min cooldown 24 Mana This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Target an enemy and leap into the air, becoming immune to all physical attacks and spells for 2 sec.    At the end of the duration, you charge back down, dealing 127 Holy damage to all enemies within 8 yds.

Name: Vampire Lord
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Dealing damage with your Shadow Priest damage over time spells or healing with Shadow Mend generates a stack of Vampiric Essence.     Mind Flay generates 2 stacks per tick.    Each tick of Mind Sear can consume 3 Vampiric Essence to heal up to 5 allies for 199 health.    Vampiric Essence can stack up to 30 times.

Name: Vampiric Death
Description: Shadow Word: Death consumes your Vampiric Touch on the target, dealing Shadow damage equal to 100% of its total damage. This is increased to 220% if Shadow Word: Death critically strikes.    Shadow Word: Death's self-inflicted damage is reduced by 80%.

Name: Vampiric Tonic
Description: Teaches you: Vampiric Tonic    Vampiric Tonic 3 min cooldown 50 Rage This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Drink a vampiric tonic, causing Physical damage dealt to heal you for 10% of the damage dealt for 15 sec. This healing cannot exceed 10% of your maximum health per heal.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Vampirism
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Your Vampiric Embrace healing now scales with Healing Power and heals the lowest-health ally in your party or raid. It no longer provides additional healing to you.    Targets do not need to be in your party or raid. Each heal cannot exceed 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Vengeful Plague
Description: While Seal of Vengeance is active, your Blood Plague now deals 50% more damage.

Name: Venomous Wound
Description: Critical strikes with Slam, Overpower or Mortal Strike against a bleeding target afflict them with Venomous Wound.    Venomous Wound Target takes 75% more damage from your Instant Poison. Holds 3 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Victorious Charge
Description: Casting Charge now grants you Victorious, allowing you to cast Victory Rush once.    This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.    Victorious Allows the use of Victory Rush!

Name: Victorious Stand
Description: Dealing damage with Victory Rush reduces Last Stands cooldown by 10 sec.     Using Last Stand grants one use of Victory Rush, which will further reduce its cooldown by 35 sec.

Name: Viper's Bite
Description: Teaches you: Viper's Bite    Viper's Bite 20 sec cooldown 60 Focus This spell belongs to Ranger    Unleash 4 quick strikes over 1 sec. Each strike deals 40% weapon damage and generates 1 combo point.    Against a bleeding target, each strike also deals 10% Physical weapon damage. Against a poisoned target, each strike also deals 10% Nature weapon damage.    Requires a one-handed weapon. Usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Viscera
Description: The periodic damage of Lacerate, Thrash, and auto attacks have a 15% chance of resetting the cooldown of Pulverize, and makes your next Pulverize hit up to 3 targets.

Name: Voice of Bwonsamdi
Description: Teaches you: Voice of Bwonsamdi    Voice of Bwonsamdi 5 min cooldown 9 Mana This spell belongs to Witch Doctor    Let the spirit of Bwonsamdi possess you for 15 sec.    Dealing periodic damage unleashes a trapped voodoo spirit at enemies, exploding for 0 Shadow damage.

Name: Voidborne
Description: Teaches you: Voidborne    Voidborne 3 min cooldown 8 Health This spell belongs to Cultist    Tap into your inner voidborne rage, increasing your damage dealt and critical strike chance by 25%, and granting you immunity to stun effects for 10 sec.

Name: Volcanic Shamanism
Description: Lava Burst reduces the active cooldown of Flame Ascendance by 8 seconds.

Name: Volcanic Shell
Description: Teaches you: Volcanic Shell    Volcanic Shell 2 min cooldown 12 Mana This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Conjure a shield of magma and fire around you, absorbing 500 damage. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Voltaic Companion
Description: Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks now deal Nature damage.    Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks can only be transformed to one damage type at once.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Wacky Wizardry
Description: Your offensive Mage spell casts have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Mage spell for free.

Name: Wanding
Description: Wand attacks grant you stacks that increase the cast speed of your next spell by 5%, stacks up to 5 times and lasts 6 sec.

Name: War Golem

Description: Requires  Execute (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Storming Execution    Storming Execution 15 Rage Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 65% of 65 Stormstrike damage and converting each extra point of rage into 65% of 2 additional Stormstrike damage (up to a maximum cost of 30 rage). Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.  This uses Execute modifiers.

Name: Stormpierce
Description: Requires  Backstab (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Stormpierce    Stormpierce 50 Energy Pierce the target, causing 100% weapon damage as Stormstrike plus 7 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.  This uses Backstab modifiers.

Name: Stormreaver
Description: Requires  Crusader Strike  Teaches you: Stormreaver    Stormreaver 4 sec cooldown 4 Mana An instant storm strike that causes 50% weapon damage as Stormstrike damage.    This uses Crusader Strike modifiers.

Name: Stormshred
Description: Requires  Shred (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Stormshred    Stormshred 60 Energy Shred the target, causing 145% weapon damage plus 15 as Stormstrike damage to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point. Effects which increase bleed damage also increase Stormshred damage.    This uses Shred modifiers.

Name: Summon Void Zone
Description: Teaches you: Summon Void Zone    Summon Void Zone 30 yd range 30 sec cooldown 12 Mana Summons a Void Zone at the target location, dealing 55 Shadow damage. Enemies within 4 yards take 25 to 29 damage every 2 sec and take 5% increased Shadow damage for 10 sec.

Name: Sunburst
Description: Requires  Starsurge (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Sunburst    Sunburst 30 yd range 10 sec cooldown 5 Mana 1.5 sec cast Deals 84 Nature damage to the target and 4 enemies within 5 yards.    This uses Starsurge modifiers.

Name: Sunder Soul
Description: Teaches you: Sunder Soul    Sunder Soul 3 Mana Sunders the target's soul, dealing 65% Shadowstrike weapon damage (52% if a two-handed weapon is equipped) plus 3 and increases your spell critical strike chance against the target by 3%. Stacks 5 times and lasts for 15 sec.    This uses Devastate modifiers.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Sunfire
Description: Teaches you: Sunfire    Sunfire 30 yd range 10 sec cooldown 20 Mana Burns your target and 4 additional targets within 8 yards, dealing 9 to 12 Firestorm damage and 30 additional damage over 15 sec.

Name: Symbiotic Serendipity
Description: Requires  Serendipity (Rank 3)  Direct Nature heals now trigger Serendipity.    Serendipity When you heal with Binding Heal or Flash Heal, cast Renew, or deal damage with Smite, the cast time and mana cost of your next Greater Heal or Prayer of Healing spell is reduced by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Synchronize
Description: Requires  Arcane Missiles (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Synchronize    Synchronize 40 yd range 14 Mana Heals all nearby Aligned or Time-bound allies every second for 4 seconds. While channeling, time is stalled, freezing the duration of your active Aligned buffs.    Max 2 charges. 6 second recharge timer.    Casting Synchronize consumes 70 energy, if Temporal Distortion or Eternity is known.    This uses Arcane Missiles modifiers.

Name: Syndicate Sniper Shot
Description: Teaches you: Syndicate Sniper Shot    Syndicate Sniper Shot 35 yd range 60 Energy 3 sec cast Fire a shot from Stealth, dealing 205% weapon damage plus 11. Awards 2 combo points.

Name: Tectonic Shockwave
Description: Requires  Shockwave  This uses Shockwave modifiers.  Teaches you: Tectonic Shockwave    Tectonic Shockwave 10 yd range 16 sec cooldown 15 Rage Unleashes a wave of force in front of you, dealing 144 Physical damage and granting you Tectonic Echo for each enemy hit causing your next Earth Shock to hit 1 additional target. Stacks up to 6 times and lasts 20 sec.

Name: Tempest Shield Slam
Description: Requires  Shield Slam (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Tempest Shield Slam    Tempest Shield Slam 6 sec cooldown 20 Rage Slam the target with your shield, causing 191 to 199 Stormstrike damage, modified by your shield block value, and dispels 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a high amount of threat.  This uses Shield Slam modifiers.

Name: Tempest Smash
Description: Requires  Thunder Clap (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Tempest Smash    Tempest Smash 6 sec cooldown 20 Rage Blasts nearby enemies dealing 10 Stormstrike damage and increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.    This uses Thunder Clap modifiers.

Name: Templar's Slash
Description: Teaches you: Templar's Slash    Templar's Slash 8 Mana 1.25 sec cast Launch a powerful swing, dealing 150% weapon damage to up to 6 enemies in a cone in front of you.    Max 3 charges, 8 seconds recharge timer.

Name: Temporal Blast
Description: Requires  Arcane Blast (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Temporal Blast    Temporal Blast 30 yd range 6 Mana 2.5 sec cast Blasts your target with energy, dealing 143 Arcane damage.    If canceled early, your next Temporal Blast is reduced by the time spent casting.    Casting this increases all Arcane damage by 15% and its mana cost by 150%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 6 sec. Removed if you cast another Arcane ability that deals damage.    This uses Arcane Blast modifiers.

Name: Temporal Rift
Description: Requires  Arcane Explosion (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Temporal Rift    Temporal Rift 17 Mana Create a temporal rift that explodes after 4 seconds, dealing 43 to 50 Arcane damage to enemies within 10 yards.     Max 3 charges. 10 seconds recharge timer.    This uses Arcane Explosion modifiers.

Name: Temporal Shield
Description: Teaches you: Temporal Shield    Temporal Shield 1 min cooldown Envelops you in a temporal shield for 4 sec. If the shield lasts its full duration, 75% of the damage taken is instantly restored.

Name: Thief of Fate
Description: Requires  Pick Pocket  Teaches you: Thief of Fate    Thief of Fate 8 sec cooldown Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. Stolen effects last a maximum of 2 min.    Does not break stealth.    This uses Pick Pocket modifiers.

Name: Thrash (Bear)
Description: Requires  Swipe (Bear) (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Thrash (Bear)    Thrash (Bear) 8 yd range 6 sec cooldown 20 Rage Deals 9 damage, and causes all targets within 8 yards to bleed for 2 damage over 10 sec sec, this bleed can stack up to 5 times.    This ability scales with modifiers to Swipe (Bear).

Name: Throw Weapon
Description: Teaches you: Throw Weapon    Throw Weapon 20 yd range 2 min cooldown Throws your weapon, inflicting 100% weapon damage and stunning the target for 1 second. Disarms you for 2 sec.

Name: Thrust
Description: Requires  Sinister Strike (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Thrust    Thrust 45 Energy An instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to 100% of your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point and ignores 20% of the armor.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Thunder Hide
Description: Requires  Lightning Shield (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Thunder Hide    Thunder Hide The caster's fur becomes electrically charged, reducing damage taken from creatures by 5%.    When hit by a spell, melee, or ranged attack, the attacker is struck for 13 Nature damage. This consumes a charge of Thunder Hide and lasts 10 min.    This uses Lightning Shield modifiers. This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Thunder Slam
Description: Requires  Slam (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Thunder Slam    Thunder Slam 15 Rage 1.5 sec cast Slams up to 5 nearby opponents, causing 30% Nature weapon damage plus 17 Nature damage within a 10-yard frontal cone.     This uses Slam modifiers.

Name: Thundering Bloodstrike
Description: Requires  Blood Strike (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Thundering Bloodstrike    Thundering Bloodstrike Instantly strike the enemy, causing 25% weapon damage as Stormstrike plus 8, total damage increased by 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.  This uses Blood Strike modifiers.

Name: Thundering Riposte
Description: Requires  Riposte  Teaches you: Thundering Riposte    Thundering Riposte 6 sec cooldown 10 Energy A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 100% weapon damage as Stormstrike and slows their melee attack speed by 20% for 30 sec. Awards 1 combo point.  This uses Riposte modifiers.

Name: Thunderlizard Bite
Description: Requires  Mongoose Bite (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Thunderlizard Bite    Thunderlizard Bite 5 sec cooldown 2 Mana Attack the enemy for 11 Stormstrike damage.    This uses Mongoose Bite modifiers.

Name: Thunderwave
Description: Requires  Shockwave  Teaches you: Thunderwave    Thunderwave 20 sec cooldown 15 Rage Sends a wave of force in front of the caster, causing 4 Stormstrike damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets in a frontal cone for 4 sec.  This uses Shockwave modifiers.

Name: Time Bomb
Description: Teaches you: Time Bomb    Time Bomb 30 yd range 2 min cooldown Applies a Time Bomb to the enemy that stores 50% of your Arcane damage dealt against the target and detonates it after 10 sec.    Dealing damage with Arcane Barrage decreases the cooldown by 8 seconds.

Name: Time Warp
Description: Requires  Blink  Teaches you: Time Warp    Time Warp 40 yd range 3 sec cooldown Returns you to your active Temporal Anomaly.    While you know this spell casting Blink leaves behind a Temporal Anomaly.

Name: Time-bind
Description: Requires  Renew (Rank 9)  Teaches you: Time-bind    Time-bind 40 yd range 6 sec cooldown 10 Mana Requires  Path of Healing  Creates a bond with Eternity with your ally. After 6 sec, it applies a periodic heal, restoring 30% of the damage taken during the bond. This effect is increased by healing power.    Casting Time-bind consumes 30 energy, if Temporal Distortion or Eternity is known.    Duration cannot be extended.    Only one target can be affected by Time-bind at a time.    This uses Renew modifiers.

Name: Titanic Mutilate
Description: Requires  Mutilate (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Titanic Mutilate    Titanic Mutilate 50 Energy Instantly attacks with both weapons for 70% weapon damage. Damage is increased by 20% against bleeding targets. Awards 2 combo points.    This uses Mutilate modifiers.

Name: Titanic Strike
Description: Teaches you: Titanic Strike    Titanic Strike 50 Energy Strike with both weapons, dealing weapon damage per combo point.     1 point  : 90% combined weapon damage     2 points: 120% combined weapon damage     3 points: 150% combined weapon damage     4 points: 180% combined weapon damage     5 points: 210% combined weapon damage

Name: Touch of Elune
Description: Teaches you: Touch of Elune    Touch of Elune 30 yd range 1 min cooldown 33 Mana Place the Touch of Elune on an enemy. For the next 10 sec, casting Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge spells to other targets also triggers them on the target marked by your Touch of Elune.    Increases the damage and critical strike chance of Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge by 15%.

Name: Trap Launcher: Explosive Trap
Description: Requires  Explosive Trap (Rank 1) This uses Explosive Trap modifiers. Teaches you: Trap Launcher: Explosive Trap   Trap Launcher: Explosive Trap 30 yd range 30 sec cooldown 32 Mana Launches your Explosive Trap at the target location.

Name: Trap Launcher: Immolation Trap
Description: Requires  Immolation Trap (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Trap Launcher: Immolation Trap    Trap Launcher: Immolation Trap 30 yd range 30 sec cooldown 14 Mana Launches your Immolation Trap at the target location.

Name: Tree of Wrath
Description: Requires  Tree of Life (Shapeshift)  Teaches you: Tree of Wrath    Tree of Wrath 22 Mana Grants the ability to shapeshift into the Tree of Wrath, freeing you from all movement impairing effects.    While active, you increase your party and raid's healing received by 6%.    In this form, you can only cast healing spells, Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning, and their chance to hit is increased by 100%.    Tree of Wrath reduces the mana cost of your Druid healing over time spells by 20%.

Name: Twilight Shock
Description: Requires  Shadowburn (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Twilight Shock    Twilight Shock 30 yd range 12 sec cooldown 16 Mana Instantly blasts the target for 132 Twilight damage and causes the target to take 9 damage every 2 seconds for 6 sec.    This uses Shadowburn modifiers.

Name: Twisted Mind
Description: Requires  Fel Armor (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Twisted Mind    Twisted Mind 1.5 sec cooldown 10 Mana Your mind becomes twisted, increasing your spell power by 1 and your hit chance by 3%, but reduces your healing and absorbs by 5%.    This cannot be used together with other bar-changing abilities such as Stances or Forms.

Name: Tyr's Deliverance
Description: Teaches you: Tyr's Deliverance    Tyr's Deliverance 2 min cooldown 17 Mana 1.5 sec cast Releases the Light within yourself, healing 10 injured allies for 401 within 40 yards. Afterward, heals 3 allies for 161 every 1 sec for 15 sec.

Name: Umbral Shield Slam
Description: Requires  Shield Slam (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Umbral Shield Slam    Umbral Shield Slam 6 sec cooldown 20 Rage Slam the target with your shield, causing 191 to 199 Shadowstrike damage, modified by your shield block value, and dispels 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a high amount of threat.  This uses Shield Slam modifiers.

Name: Umbral Smash
Description: Requires  Thunder Clap (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Umbral Smash    Umbral Smash 6 sec cooldown 20 Rage Blasts nearby enemies dealing 10 Shadowstrike damage and increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.    This uses Thunder Clap modifiers.

Name: Unchained Blink
Description: Requires  Blink  Teaches you: Unchained Blink    Unchained Blink 15 sec cooldown 17 Mana Teleports the caster 20 yards forward.    This ability can be used while casting, but not channeling, and does not trigger a global cooldown.    This uses Blink modifiers.

Name: Unrelenting Wrath
Description: Requires  Bestial Wrath This uses Bestial Wrath modifiers. Teaches you: Unrelenting Wrath   Unrelenting Wrath 100 yd range 6 sec cooldown 8 Mana Send your Tamed Pet into a rage for 8 sec causing 30% additional damage, reducing its threat generated by 15%, and resetting the cooldown of your Frenzy Shot.    Max 2 charges. 2 minute recharge timer. Bestial Assault rapidly restores charges.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.    Will trigger a lesser version of Beast Within if any rank is known, you are not immune to crowd control effects during this.

Name: Unstable Evocation
Description: Requires  Evocation  Teaches you: Unstable Evocation    Unstable Evocation 1 min cooldown While channeling, you are immune to interrupts, silences and stuns, and you gain 32% of your total mana over 4 sec. After completing Unstable Evocation, nearby enemies are blasted with 56 Arcane damage and knocked back.    This scales with Evocation modifiers.

Name: Upheaval
Description: Requires  Lava Lash  Teaches you: Upheaval    Upheaval 15 yd range 6 sec cooldown 20 Rage You stomp the ground, causing a stone spike to erupt beneath your target, dealing 150% off-hand Weapon damage. Deals 125% increased damage if your off-hand weapon is imbued with Rockbiter Weapon.    This uses Lava Lash modifiers.

Name: Vampiric Bite
Description: Requires  Vampiric Touch (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Vampiric Bite    Vampiric Bite 30 Rage Deals 66 Shadow damage every 3 seconds and increases your chance to critically strike the target by 3%. Lasts 15 sec.    This uses Vampiric Touch modifiers. This periodic damage can critically strike.

Name: Veil of Shadows
Description: Requires  Curse of the Elements (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Veil of Shadows    Veil of Shadows 30 yd range 8 Mana 1.5 sec cast Veil the target with sinister shadow magic, dealing 37 Shadow damage every 2 seconds for 20 sec.    Reduces all magical resistances by 45 and increases magic damage taken by 6% and applies Corrupting Shadows.    Does not stack with other similar effects. This uses Curse of the Elements modifiers.    Corrupting Shadows Reduces healing received by 30% for 8 sec.

Name: Venom Belch
Description: Teaches you: Venom Belch    Venom Belch 20 yd range 10 sec cooldown 4 Mana 1.5 sec cast Spawns a pool of vile poison at the target location that inflicts 3 Nature damage to nearby enemies every 1 second for 10 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Venomous Fury
Description: Teaches you: Venomous Fury    Venomous Fury 35 Energy Finishing move that deals Stormstrike damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy (up to a maximum of 30 extra energy) into 0.7 additional damage:      1 point  : 13-16 damage      2 points: 21-24 damage      3 points: 30-33 damage      4 points: 38-41 damage      5 points: 47-50 damage    This uses Ferocious Bite modifiers.

Name: Void Lash
Description: Requires  Lava Lash  Teaches you: Void Lash    Void Lash 6 sec cooldown 3 Mana You charge your off-hand weapon with elemental force, instantly dealing 100% off-hand Weapon damage as Shadowstrike damage.     Damage is increased by 25% if your off-hand weapon is enchanted with Windfury.    This uses Lava Lash modifiers.

Name: Void Multi-Shot
Description: Requires  Multi-Shot (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Void Multi-Shot    Void Multi-Shot 35 yd range 10 sec cooldown 7 Mana Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets for 65% weapon damage as Shadowstrike.  This uses Multi-Shot modifiers.

Name: Void Spree
Description: Requires  Killing Spree  Teaches you: Void Spree    Void Spree 10 yd range 2 min cooldown Step through the shadows from enemy to enemy within 10 yards, attacking an enemy for 85% weapon damage as Shadowstrike every 0.5 sec with both weapons until 5 assaults are made. Can hit the same target multiple times. Cannot hit invisible or stealthed targets.  This uses Killing Spree modifiers.

Name: Void Strike
Description: Requires  Sinister Strike (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Void Strike    Void Strike 45 Energy An instant shadow-infused strike that causes 3 Shadowstrike damage in addition to 65% of your normal weapon damage (55% if a two-handed weapon is equipped). Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Voidbound Cleave
Description: Requires  Cleave (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Voidbound Cleave    Voidbound Cleave 20 Rage A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 9 as Shadowstrike damage to the target and his nearest ally.    This uses Cleave modifiers.

Name: Voidbound Shot
Description: Requires  Aimed Shot (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Voidbound Shot    Voidbound Shot 35 yd range 10 sec cooldown 6 Mana An aimed shot that deals 100% weapon damage plus 12 as Shadowstrike damage and reduces healing done to that target by 50%. Lasts 10 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This uses Aimed Shot modifiers.

Name: Voidchaser
Description: Requires  Overpower  Teaches you: Voidchaser    Voidchaser 5 sec cooldown 5 Rage Instantly strike the enemy, causing 65% weapon damage as Shadowstrike damage. Only usable after the target dodges. Voidchaser cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.    This uses Overpower modifiers.

Name: Voidwave
Description: Requires  Shockwave  Teaches you: Voidwave    Voidwave 20 sec cooldown 15 Rage Sends a wave of force in front of the caster, causing 4 Shadowstrike damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets in a frontal cone for 4 sec.  This uses Shockwave modifiers.

Name: Volt Spike
Description: Requires  Hemorrhage (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Volt Spike    Volt Spike 35 Energy An instant strike that deals 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike and applies Hemorrhage, increasing Physical damage taken by up to 9. Lasts 10 charges or 15 sec. Awards 1 combo point.  Deals 114% weapon damage as Stormstrike if a dagger is equipped and 55% if a two-hander is equipped.  This uses Hemorrhage modifiers.

Name: Volt Strike
Description: Requires  Sinister Strike (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Volt Strike    Volt Strike 45 Energy An instant storm-infused strike that causes 3 Stormstrike damage in addition to 65% of your normal weapon damage (55% if a two-handed weapon is equipped). Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Voltaic Bite
Description: Teaches you: Voltaic Bite    Voltaic Bite 8 sec cooldown 6 Mana Instantly bite the target for 150% weapon damage as Nature.    This uses Stormstrike modifiers.

Name: Warbreaker
Description: Requires  Colossus Smash (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Warbreaker    Warbreaker 30 sec cooldown 15 Rage Stomp the ground, dealing 90% armor piercing weapon damage to nearby enemies and causing your attacks to pierce 30% of their armor for 10 sec.    This uses Colossus Smash modifiers.

Name: Warcry
Description: Teaches you: Warcry    Warcry 2 min cooldown Increases your melee and ranged critical strike chance by 15% for 15 sec.

Name: Water Ascendance
Description: Teaches you: Water Ascendance    Water Ascendance 2 min cooldown 5 Mana Transform into a being of raw elemental power for 15 sec, applying Riptide (if known) to 4 nearby allies.     While active, your Chain Heal is infused with healing waters and now jumps to twice as many allies.     You can cast Shaman Nature healing spells while moving but your movement speed is reduced by 40%.

Name: Water Nova
Description: Requires  Frost Nova (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Water Nova    Water Nova 30 yd range 20 sec cooldown 5 Mana Deals 15 Frost damage to all enemies in the area.    This uses Frost Nova modifiers.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Wave of Despair
Description: Requires  Seed of Corruption (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Wave of Despair    Wave of Despair 30 yd range 12 sec cooldown 26 Mana Unleash a shadowy onslaught, dealing 632 Shadow damage to 8 enemies.    This uses Seed of Corruption modifiers.

Name: Wendigo Bite
Description: Requires  Mongoose Bite (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Wendigo Bite    Wendigo Bite 5 sec cooldown 2 Mana Attack the enemy for 11 Froststrike damage.    This uses Mongoose Bite modifiers.

Name: Whirling Aether
Description: Requires  Whirlwind  Teaches you: Whirling Aether    Whirling Aether 10 sec cooldown 25 Rage In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Spellstrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Flames
Description: Requires  Whirlwind  Teaches you: Whirling Flames    Whirling Flames 10 sec cooldown 25 Rage In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Firestrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Ice
Description: Requires  Whirlwind  Teaches you: Whirling Ice    Whirling Ice 10 sec cooldown 25 Rage In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Froststrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Light
Description: Requires  Whirlwind  Teaches you: Whirling Light    Whirling Light 10 sec cooldown 25 Rage In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Holystrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Shadows
Description: Requires  Whirlwind  Teaches you: Whirling Shadows    Whirling Shadows 10 sec cooldown 25 Rage In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Shadowstrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Storm
Description: Requires  Whirlwind  Teaches you: Whirling Storm    Whirling Storm 10 sec cooldown 25 Rage In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Winds of Winter
Description: Requires  Cone of Cold (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Winds of Winter    Winds of Winter 5 sec cooldown 20 Mana Finishing move that deals Frost damage per combo point to enemies in a cone in front of the caster:     1 point  : 36-57 damage     2 points: 70-91 damage     3 points: 104-125 damage     4 points: 138-159 damage     5 points: 173-194 damage    This uses Cone of Cold modifiers.

Name: Winterfall Firebreath
Description: Requires  Cone of Cold (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Winterfall Firebreath    Winterfall Firebreath 10 sec cooldown 20 Mana Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 80 to 88 Fire damage and an additional 6 Fire damage every 2 seconds for 6 sec. Enemies hit are slowed by 30%.     This uses Cone of Cold modifiers.  This ability can be used while shapeshifted.

Name: Worgen Form
Description: Requires  Cat Form (Shapeshift)  Teaches you: Worgen Form    Worgen Form 28 Mana Transform into a Worgen, increasing melee attack power by 1 plus 25% of Agility, allowing the use of Cat Form and Shadow Priest abilities.     Grants Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, and Vampiric Touch the ability to benefit from haste.    Direct Shadow damage reduces the cooldown of Goldrinn's Fury by 2 seconds.

Name: Wraith
Description: Requires  Haunt (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Wraith    Wraith 30 yd range 8 sec cooldown 40 Energy Finishing move that haunts your target, dealing damage and increasing the damage of your Physical damage-over-time effects against it.   When Wraith ends or is dispelled, it heals you for 100% of the direct damage done.    1 point : 111 Physical damage; 2% increase for 12 sec    2 points: 191 Physical damage; 4% increase for 12 sec    3 points: 270 Physical damage; 6% increase for 12 sec    4 points: 350 Physical damage; 8% increase for 12 sec    5 points: 430 Physical damage; 10% increase for 12 sec    This uses Haunt modifiers.

Name: Wyrm Bite
Description: Requires  Mongoose Bite (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Wyrm Bite    Wyrm Bite 5 sec cooldown 2 Mana Attack the enemy for 11 Spellstrike damage.    This uses Mongoose Bite modifiers.

Name: Zandalari Glaive
Description: Requires  Glaive Toss (Rank 1)  Teaches you: Zandalari Glaive    Zandalari Glaive 35 yd range 20 sec cooldown 13 Mana Hurl two glaives toward the target, each dealing 120% melee weapon damage.    This uses Glaive Toss modifiers and shares a cooldown with Glaive Toss.

Name: Zulian Guardian
Description: Requires  Feral Spirit  This uses Feral Spirit modifiers.  Teaches you: Zulian Guardian    Zulian Guardian 30 yd range 3 min cooldown 9 Mana Summons two prowling Zulian Guardians for 20 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.    This uses Feral Spirits modifiers.

Name: Abjurer's Ward: Arcane
Description: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of Presence of Mind by 10 seconds.

Name: Abjurer's Ward: Fire
Description: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of your Combustion by 10 seconds.

Name: Abjurer's Ward: Frost
Description: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of Cold Snap by 10 seconds.

Name: Adrenaline Junkie
Description: Your finishing moves have a 4% chance per combo point to reduce the cooldown of Adrenaline Rush by 6 seconds.

Name: Aegis
Description: Each time a melee attack strikes you, you have a chance to gain 6 armor for 10 sec.

Name: Against All Odds
Description: Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor while below 20% health instantly heals you for 10% of your health.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

Name: Agile Coordination
Description: Your finishing moves have a 5% chance per combo point to grant your Tamed Pet Agile Coordination.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin or Tether Elemental, and Tame Beast.    Agile Coordination Increases your Tamed Pet's attack power by 15% of your Agility for 8 sec.

Name: Aligned with Time
Description: Time-Bind now increases the healing your ally receives from your Align by 15%.

Name: Ambidextrous
Description: Your Single-Minded Fury off-hand attacks trigger an instant attack with your main-hand weapon and grant you Dominant.    Dominant Increases your attack power by 10% for 9 sec.  This effect can only occur once every 16 sec and Dominant cannot be active at the same time as Southpaw.

Name: Arcane Aiming
Description: When Clearcasting is consumed, you gain Arcane Aiming.  Does not trigger from Elemental Clearcasting consumption.   Arcane Aiming Your next 3 Hunter Shots deal 11 additional Arcane damage and restore 6% of your total mana. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Armor of Wrath
Description: Casting Hammer of Wrath now reduces your damage taken by 12% for 6 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 12 sec.

Name: Bane of the Wicked
Description: Hammer of the Righteous now applies Bane of the Wicked to enemies hit.    Bane of the Wicked Increases Holy damage taken from you by 4% for 15 sec. Stacking up to 5.    The duration of Bane of the Wicked cannot be refreshed.

Name: Black Ice Arsenal
Description: Dealing damage with Howling Blast, Icy Touch, and Frost Strike applies Black Ice.      Black Ice Increases damage taken from the caster's next Frostbolt and Frostfire Bolt by 20%. Stacks up to 3. Lasts for 12 sec.

Name: Blind Rage
Description: You now generate 10 rage after each missed attack.

Name: Blood Drinker
Description: Your Bloodthirst now consumes Taste for Blood to heal you for 4.

Name: Blood Hunting

Description: Decreases the mana cost of Volley by 20%.

Plague-Tipped Vulnerability Next Auto shot increases damage taken from your Frost Fever and Blood Plague by 3% per stack. Stacks up to 10 times.

Description: Your Tamed Pet's damage is increased by 20% while Berserk is active.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Holy Guardian
Description: Increases your threat generated by Holy damage by 40%.  Reduces all damage taken by 2%.

Description: Dealing damage with Frost Strike, Howling Blast or Icy Touch reduces the cooldown of Cold Blood by 8 seconds.  When Cold Blood is consumed, the cooldown of Deathchill is reduced by 40 sec.

Poison Bomb Combo Causes your Poison Bomb to deal 19 Nature damage   This damaged is increased by each Poison Bomb Combo stacks stacking up to 3 times.

Name: Providing for Nature

Description: Dealing damage with Pyroblast refreshes the duration of your Corruption.

Description: Reduces the cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 2 rage points and increases its radius by 10%.

Description: Dealing damage with Colossus Smash, Counterattack, Execute, and Savage Blade resets the cooldown of Raptor Strike.

Your Frost Fever deals 100% increased periodic damage and can critically strike.    Rimebound Shadow Your next Grave Coil triggers a 18 Shadowfrost damage around the target.  This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Runeforged Verdict Increases direct damage of your next Frost Strike, Heart Strike or Obliterate by 30%.

Stacks up to 3. Lasts 12 seconds.
